title: Senior Backend Engineer (Europe)
description:
About Trigger.dev

Trigger.dev is the platform for running reliable AI agents and workflows. Developers use it to build, deploy, and scale production systems with built-in tools for orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and debugging.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. Today, we serve thousands of teams building AI apps and agents, handling hundreds of millions of executions per month.

About the position

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us build our Open Source and Cloud product. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Redis, and cloud infrastructure. This role requires both technical depth and the ability to think strategically about our platform's future.

What you'll be doing

You'll do a variety of things including:

  • Designing and implementing SDK and platform features. Shipping new capabilities end to end, from API surface to production rollout.

  • Database design. Developing database schemas and data models that hold up as the product scales.

  • Query performance and data access. Creating and optimising query performance and data access patterns.

  • Building backend systems that stand up to production load. Reliability, throughput, and durability are part of the job, not someone else's.

  • Scalable APIs and services. Designing and implementing API endpoints and services that handle real customer traffic.

  • Security as a default. Applying security best practices in everything you ship.

  • Monitoring, logging, and debugging. Implementing the observability tooling that lets us spot problems and fix them fast.

  • Architecture and technical roadmap. Contributing to architectural decisions and shaping where the platform goes next.

We build in public, so you can see some of the things you might work on here.

Working at a Commercial Open Source Software company is more than just coding:

  • We have an active community on Discord and GitHub. Everyone on the team helps customers, reviews PRs, and creates issues.

  • Having great documentation is essential. Everyone writes docs.

  • We're a product-led growth company, so everyone is expected to get involved in creating content like code examples, blog articles, videos, and tweets.

Requirements

You really need to have:

  • Expertise in Node.js and TypeScript. We use Remix.

  • Expertise with Postgres and Redis. You've designed schemas, tuned queries, and run these in production.

  • Cloud infrastructure experience. AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Comfortable being on call. Reliability is a shared responsibility for the engineering team.

  • Open to in-person events throughout the year. If you're remote, we'll arrange these so the team gets real time together.

You'll be an amazing fit if you have:

  • A proven track record of contributing to open source projects.

  • Previously been a venture-backed startup founder.

  • Experience with React, or better still, Remix.

  • Worked on a high throughput system.

  • Designed SDKs for developers.

  • Experience with self-managed Kubernetes.

  • Familiarity with Linux.

  • OTel or "o11y" experience.

  • Worked at a developer tools company.

  • Experience with Go.

About the team

  • We are a small team with a flat hierarchy.

  • We encourage continuous learning and personal development.

  • Everyone operates autonomously; we trust you to get the job done, but to also quickly raise your hand if you need help.

  • We care about our customers and the open-source community.

  • Being a start-up, the work is challenging and fast-paced, but we also understand the importance of taking time off to recharge.

Benefits

  • Generous, transparent compensation and equity - We hire the best talent and pay to reflect that. We also offer equity as a way to ensure everyone is invested in the success of the company.

  • Async working - Need a heads-down day or meeting-free days to stay productive? No problem!

  • Home office - We will help provide equipment for a comfortable setup so you're as productive at home as you are in the office.

  • Generous vacation - We believe it's important to take time off. We encourage you to take your 25 days vacation excluding national holidays, plus sick leave and generous parental leave.

  • Training budget - An annual budget to contribute towards learning such as purchasing books, an Audible subscription or online courses.

  • Pension and 401k contributions - Enroll in our company pension scheme or we'll contribute directly to your private pension.

Our values

  • We are proud to be open source - We believe in the open source community and building a great free-to-use product. We encourage community contributions and are public about what we are building.

  • We ship uncomfortably fast - As a startup, moving fast is key. We are pragmatic about what we build, when we build it, and value iterative development above all.

  • Working autonomously - We don't tell you what to do. We decide as a team what will have the biggest impact for our customers and prioritise what we work on from that.

Interview process

  1. Application. We'll review your application, CV, and any code samples or open source contributions you share.

  2. Screening call. A chat about your background, the systems you've built, and what you're looking for next.

  3. Hiring manager call. A deeper technical conversation about your work and how you'd approach the role.

  4. Paid task day. You'll spend a paid day working on a real engineering problem with us, then walk us through your thinking with the team.

  5. Final interview. A call with a couple of members of the wider team to answer any remaining questions and align on culture fit.

  6. References & offer. If everyone is happy, we'll make you an offer to join us.

If this sounds like your dream job, we can't wait to hear from you. If you're not sure that you exactly fit these requirements, get in touch anyway!

title: Design Engineer

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. With the rise of AI, being able to offload async tasks reliably is a key part of any developer's toolkit - we're building the infrastructure to make that a reality.

We're a small team shipping fast, and as we accelerate building new features and expand the team, we want to make sure the quality and polish of what we ship keeps pace. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Design Engineer to help raise the bar on UX and visual quality across our product and marketing surfaces. You'll blend design sensibility with real engineering ability, and be able to take a rough idea, a Figma file, or even just a problem statement, and turn it into a well-crafted, production-quality experience yourself, without needing a traditional design-to-dev handoff.

  • Great documentation matters more than ever, both for humans and for the AI tools that read it. Everyone here keeps docs up to date

  • We are a product-led growth company so everyone is expected to get involved in creating content like code examples, blog articles, videos and tweets

Benefits

  • Generous, transparent compensation and equity - We hire the best talent and pay to reflect that. We also offer equity as a way to ensure everyone is invested in the success of the company.

title: Engineering Manager - Design System (x/f/m)
description:
Your mission

At Doctolib, we're building digital health solutions used by more than 90 million patients and 520,000 healthcare professionals across Europe. The quality, consistency, and accessibility of our interfaces are critical to that mission. That's exactly what our Design System team makes possible.

As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. Oxygen goes far beyond a component library: it is the infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale and delivers our brand identity consistently across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib.

Working at the intersection of Design and Engineering, you will partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to turn our Design System vision into scalable technical solutions that power consistent, high-quality user interfaces across all Doctolib products.

What you'll do

  • Define your team's vision, strategy, and roadmap alongside your Product partner, bringing strong technical perspectives to shape and challenge priorities, and take end-to-end ownership of engineering delivery and quality.

  • Lead the technical design, development, and evolution of Oxygen, ensuring its components and foundations are accessible, robust, reusable, and scalable across our products.

  • Champion an AI-first approach, exploring and scaling AI-powered tools and workflows that help designers and engineers build high-quality user interfaces more efficiently.

  • Establish and promote UI and accessibility engineering best practices, working closely with designers, product teams, and our accessibility specialist to drive adoption across the organization.

  • Drive technical alignment across engineering teams, fostering collaboration and ensuring the Design System integrates seamlessly across our web and mobile ecosystems.

  • Coach, mentor, and develop your engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Who you are

If you don’t meet all the requirements below but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

You could be our next teammate if you:

  • You have at least 8+ years of software engineering experience, combined with 2-3 + years of management experience

  • Have experience leading, coaching, and developing engineers, helping them grow while fostering a strong engineering culture.

  • Understand the value of design systems and have experience creating, maintaining, or contributing to component libraries that scale across multiple teams

  • Have a strong understanding of UI engineering principles and experience building consistent, high-quality user interfaces across web and mobile platforms, working closely with designers.

  • Adapt quickly to change, embracing uncertainty and consistently solving problems to achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Are committed to accessibility and understand the importance of building inclusive user experiences that comply with WCAG guidelines

  • Have proven experience developing maintainable and secure products with a focus on code quality, testing, and documentation

  • Your English skills allow you to have high quality daily interactions with the team. German or French are a plus.

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience improving developer experience and driving the adoption of shared UI components and tooling across engineering teams.

  • Have worked with cross-platform design systems, understanding the challenges of maintaining consistency across web and native mobile applications.

  • Know how to implement frontend monitoring and observability to improve UI reliability and performance.

  • Have contributed to open source or maintained internal tools/libraries

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

  • 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz

  • Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)

  • The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club

  • A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode

  • Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

The interview process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • System Design interview

  • Behavioral Interview

  • EM Case study Interview

  • Reference Check

  • Offer!

Job details

  • Permanent Position 

  • Full time 

  • Location: Levallois or Berlin or Nantes

  • Start Date: As soon as possible

  • Remote Policy: Hybrid

 

If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles! 

At Doctolib, we believe in improving access to healthcare for everyone - regardless of where you come from, what you look like. This translates into our recruitment process: Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We don't just accept diversity at Doctolib, we respect and celebrate it!

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability, or place of origin. If you have a disability, let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process smoother for you!

title: Senior Talent Partner
description:
Senior Talent Partner, Non-Technical Hiring (up to £80,000 base + early stage equity)

Location: Hybrid (3 days in London office)

About GetGround

At GetGround, our mission is simple: to make property investment safer, faster, and more accessible for landlords. We believe AI can reshape the landlord journey end to end, not just improving single steps, but reimagining the entire experience of property investing. The result will be a future of buy-to-let that looks radically different from the one we know today.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a SeniorTalent Partner to own the full hiring lifecycle across sales, marketing, and corporate functions, at every level and across the UK, Philippines, and UAE. You’ll report to the VP People, and this role is critical to our ability to build a world-class organisation.

This is your chance to build the commercial and operational teams that will take GetGround to new markets and new customers. We’re backed by QED, one of the world’s most prestigious VC funds, with an experienced leadership team that puts real weight on culture and is relentless about hiring, engaging, and retaining world-class talent.

Why this role matters

Every person we hire shapes the future of property investment. The people who sell, market, and run GetGround are the ones who turn our technology into growth. As our Senior Talent Partner, you’ll build the team that builds the business, and you’ll do it with the same innovative, AI-forward mindset that defines our approach to PropTech.

If you’re ready to take full ownership of hiring, experiment fearlessly, and attract exceptional talent to an ambitious mission, let’s talk.

What You’ll Own

  • Taking our hiring velocity, execution, and impact to the next level

  • End-to-end recruitment across sales, marketing, and corporate functions (finance, legal, operations, people and more), from entry-level to executive search

  • Running multiple searches at once across the UK, Philippines, and UAE, adapting your approach to each market’s talent landscape, norms, and hiring practices

  • Building and nurturing talent pipelines for immediate and future hiring needs

  • Partnering with hiring managers to define roles, ideal profiles, and assessment approaches

  • Sourcing creatively across channels and experimenting with AI-powered recruitment tools

  • Delivering a candidate experience that reflects our ambition and values

  • Tracking, analysing, and improving hiring metrics and processes

  • Scaling our talent acquisition strategy as we grow rapidly

Who You Are

You’ll own the hiring strategy for GetGround, and this is your chance to define what excellence in hiring looks like. You are:

A resilient problem-solver. Hiring rarely goes to plan. When pipelines dry up, roles evolve mid-search, or offers fall through, you stay calm and find a way forward.

Creative in your approach. You don’t rely solely on job boards and LinkedIn. You experiment with unconventional sourcing, craft messaging that stands out, and find talent in places others overlook. You know the best candidates often aren’t actively looking, and that a strong talent brand is critical to hiring well.

A market-savvy commercial hirer. You understand what great sales and marketing talent looks like, how to assess it, and what motivates it. You’re equally comfortable hiring an SDR, a Head of Marketing, or a Finance Director, and you adapt your approach to each.

Comfortable across borders. You can run searches across multiple regions and time zones, and you’re curious about how hiring differs between London, Manila, and Dubai.

AI-curious and ready to experiment. You’re genuinely excited about how AI is changing recruitment and eager to test new tools, workflows, and approaches. We’re building an AI-first company, and you’ll help explore what that means for how we hire.

Relentlessly results-driven. You set clear goals and hold yourself accountable. Time to hire, pipeline conversion, and offer acceptance rates all matter to you, and you keep refining your approach to improve them.

Exceptionally organised. You juggle multiple searches across functions and geographies without missing a beat. Your processes are tight, your communication is proactive, and hiring managers trust you completely.

Strategic in your thinking. You anticipate hiring needs rather than just reacting to them. You partner with leadership to understand business goals and build talent strategies that keep us ahead of our growth curve.

Scrappy and action-oriented. You know when to build the perfect system and when to move fast with what works. You’re hands-on and pragmatic, and no task is beneath you when it gets the right people in the door.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Ashby, our ATS

  • Experience hiring in the Philippines and/or the UAE

  • Background in fintech, PropTech, or high-growth startups

  • Experience building employer branding initiatives

This role isn’t for you if

  • You want fully remote work. We’re hybrid, with 3 days in the office, and we believe passionately in the advantages of in-person collaboration and innovation.

  • You’re looking for a slow-paced corporate environment. We move fast, own outcomes, and live by our values: no BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsession, and healthy ego.

What we are building: The first end-to-end real estate investment offering - making the dream of owning real estate more accessible to everyone globally.

Diversity & inclusion at GetGround: We encourage applications from all sections of society and we believe in the criticality of an inclusive culture. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other basis as protected by law.

  • 42% of our employees identify as female or non-specified, 58% as male

  • 22 nationalities represented across offices in 5 countries

  • Our work on Design Accessibility

  • Inclusion is at the heart of our culture - we celebrate and reflect on key D&I and cultural events such as: Black History Month, International Women's Day and Pride

For more information on how we store your candidate data, please see our recruitment privacy policy.

description:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD
  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit
  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote
  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)
  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden
  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen
  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen
  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln
  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen
  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden
  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)
  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)
  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID
  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework
  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.
  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab
  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL
  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD
  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1
  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.
  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt
  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche
  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, z. B. Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen
  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools
  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge
  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad
  • Gute Anbindung: S1 und Busse M48, 101, 115

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit Sara
  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit Nico und Daniel
  • Teamgespräch vor Ort
  • Angebot

Über Girona

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf unsere Lösungen, Konsentas etwa in Bürgerämtern, Gesundheitsämtern sowie Kfz-Zulassungs- und Führerscheinstellen.

Du willst ein bewährtes Produkt fit für die Zukunft machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
Behind every unforgettable trip is a travel business that needs its tools to just work. Our Solution Engineering team makes that possible: we connect WeTravel to the way organizers already run their business, so growing from ten trips to a thousand never means drowning in manual work.

As a Senior Solution Engineer, your role spans both pre- and post-sale: from technical evaluation and solution design with high-value prospects, to driving adoption and long-term implementation with existing customers. Every integration you deliver will teach us what to build next, and you’ll turn those lessons into better public interfaces for all our organizers!

About WeTravel

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform takes care of the business behind the trip: proposals, bookings, payments and customer management. That lets organizers focus on what they do best: designing and leading unforgettable experiences.

What's the role

As organizers grow, WeTravel stops being a standalone tool and becomes part of their stack. A tour operator wants bookings to flow into their own tools, payments to land in their accounting system, and leads to sync with their CRM. Getting that right is often what wins the deal, and what keeps the customer for years.

In practice, you're the technical partner organizers and our commercial team rely on, from the first discovery call to a smooth go-live. You'll understand how a travel business runs, design how WeTravel fits into it, and prove it works using our public APIs, webhooks and no-code tools like Zapier.

But the role goes beyond individual customers. As more organizers connect WeTravel to their business, every integration teaches us something about what the platform should do next. We want Solution Engineering to be the voice of our customers' integration needs inside engineering, and a stakeholder for WeTravel's public interfaces. You'll spot the patterns across deals, decide what should become a platform capability instead of a one-off, and work with product engineering teams to make it happen. A few areas where we'll need you:

  • Public API and webhooks: bring input in the roadmap of our APIs based on what customers actually try to build

  • Integration playbooks: turn recurring setups into reusable guides, templates and reference implementations

  • Pre-sales at scale: create demos, sample and solution blueprints that help our sales team answer technical questions confidently, without needing an engineer on every call

Our success here will make WeTravel easy to adopt for larger and more complex organizers, and will let our team support many more customers without growing linearly.

What you'll do day-to-day

Your time will be split roughly evenly between helping us win deals and helping customers succeed after they sign.

Pre-sales

  • Join Account Executives on discovery and demo calls, uncover the prospect's technical requirements, and map their workflows to WeTravel

  • Scope integrations and migrations, answer security and technical questionnaires, and give honest answers on what's possible today and what isn't

  • Build tailored demos and quick proofs of concept that show how WeTravel plugs into the prospect's existing tools

Implementation and support

  • Guide customers and their developers through integrations with Google Analytics, Zapier, QuickBooks, our public APIs and webhooks, as well as data migrations, complex inventory setups and go-live

  • Troubleshoot complex integration issues with customers, and make sure what you learn flows back into our docs, playbooks and product

  • Write scripts, prototypes and sample apps (Python, JavaScript, Postman collections, Zapier flows) that unblock customers and can be reused by others

Shaping the platform

  • Represent customer integration needs in product and engineering planning, backed by data from deals and tickets

  • Build and maintain our integration documentation, playbooks and internal knowledge base

  • Use AI tools to automate the repetitive parts of the job, from ticket triage to generating integration code

What success looks like

  • First month: you know our product, APIs and the most common integration setups. You've shadowed sales calls and resolved your first technical tickets end-to-end.

  • First three months: you run technical discovery and demos on your own, own customer implementations through go-live, and have shipped reusable assets .

  • First six months: you own a clear picture of what our customers try to build with WeTravel, and bring data-backed proposals into engineering planning. Your playbooks and tools mean the team takes on more customers with less custom work.

How we work

  • You'll be part of the Solutions Engineering team within our Engineering organisation.

  • You'll work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Account Management, Product and Engineering, and have a seat at the table in deal reviews.

  • We're focused on impact. We move quickly, value clarity, and adapt our processes based on what works.

  • We'd rather build something once and automated than solve it ten times by hand.

  • We use the latest hardware and are constantly on the lookout for better tools and ways to work, including AI assistants and agents.

  • Our tools: REST APIs, Postman, Zapier, HubSpot, Snowflake. Our platform runs on React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Python and Go microservices on Kubernetes.

You should apply if you have

Basic qualifications

  • A track record of 7+ years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Integration Engineer or similar)

  • Hands-on fluency with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and authentication (API keys, OAuth). You can read API docs, debug a failing request and explain why it failed

  • Familiarity with integration tools like Zapier: you can design, troubleshoot and optimise automated workflows

  • Comfort writing scripts and prototypes in at least one language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby or Go)

  • Experience leading technical discovery and demos with prospects, and owning implementations through go-live

  • The ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical people, and to translate customer needs into clear requirements for engineers

  • Good judgment about when to solve a problem for one customer and when to push for a platform solution

  • Excellent communication skills in English and experience working in multicultural, distributed teams

  • Experience using AI assistants like Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT to speed up your work

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in travel, tourism or booking platforms, including inventory and availability setups

  • Knowledge of payments, accounting, analytics or CRM integrations (e.g. QuickBooks, Xero, Google Analytics, HubSpot, Salesforce)

  • Experience influencing API design or a developer platform roadmap

  • Don’t tick every box? If the role excites you and you’ve got most of what we’re looking for, we’d still love to hear from you

Why join us?

  • Make a real impact: you'll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.

  • Shape the platform, not just tickets: your insights from customers will directly impact what our engineering teams build.

  • Work at the intersection of tech and business: you'll partner with Sales, Customer Success and Engineering every week, and see the direct impact of your work on deals won and customers launched.

  • Help build the team: you'll join a small team at an inflection point, with real ownership over how Solutions Engineering works at WeTravel.


    Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous "Time to Recharge" policy - enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.

  • Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year.

  • 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.

  • Cycle-to-work scheme (Swapfiets subscription) or commuting reimbursement.

  • Monday and Thursday lunches and after-work social events.

  • Beautiful office in central Amsterdam – rooftop garden and right by Rokin metro.

  • Extensive paid family leave.

  • Three paid volunteer days per year - take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.

  • Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.

  • Employer-sponsored pension plan with a 2% employer contribution deposited into your individual pension account.

  • Access to a 10% group discount on supplementary/additional health insurance (aanvullende verzekeringen), with the same discount available to eligible family members.

  • Access to our Booking Marketplace: Book hotels and flights for personal travel at exclusive discounted rates.

  • Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation

Ready to build something meaningful? Apply now.

Equal Opportunities

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Technical Lead – Core Services

Build the Future of AI in Financial Services

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows.

We have been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors including Puma Private Equity, and commercially supported by Lloyds Banking Group and Nationwide Building Society, we previously completed one of Scotland’s largest Series A rounds. Since then, we’ve continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we’re now scaling our team to meet that demand.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the core services that underpin Aveni’s platform.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role with responsibility for the architecture, quality and operational reliability of the foundations our product teams build upon. You’ll work across areas including client-data ingestion and preprocessing, CRM integrations and APIs, multi-tenancy, identity and authentication, and data lifecycle and retention.

You’ll lead the technical direction of a team of around six to seven engineers, remaining close to the code while making architectural decisions, setting engineering standards and helping other engineers grow.

Our platform supports regulated financial-services organisations, so reliability, security, auditability and data isolation aren’t afterthoughts — they’re fundamental to how we design and build.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Owning the technical architecture and direction of Aveni’s core platform services.

  • Designing and building scalable, event-driven services on AWS.

  • Developing and evolving our client-data ingestion capabilities, enabling new clients and data sources to be onboarded increasingly through configuration rather than bespoke engineering.

  • Building and maintaining APIs that give Aveni products a consistent way to consume client and CRM data.

  • Designing robust multi-tenant systems with strong data isolation, security and operational controls.

  • Leading our approach to data lifecycle management, including retention, deletion, residency and GDPR requirements.

  • Building resilient integrations with third-party platforms and APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, retries, reconciliation and failure recovery.

  • Making and documenting architectural decisions and representing Core Services in Architecture Review Board discussions.

  • Raising engineering standards across testing, observability, security, reliability and operational ownership.

  • Remaining hands-on with production code, primarily across Node.js and AWS.

  • Mentoring engineers through pairing, code reviews, design discussions and technical coaching.

  • Helping the team make effective use of AI-assisted engineering tools throughout the development lifecycle while maintaining strong engineering judgement and appropriate controls.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • Significant software engineering experience, with a strong track record of technical leadership and architectural decision-making.

  • Deep production experience with Node.js, particularly across backend, API and distributed systems.

  • Strong experience designing and operating cloud-native systems on AWS.

  • Experience building event-driven architectures and an understanding of the challenges that come with asynchronous distributed systems.

  • Experience designing production systems with complex multi-tenancy, data isolation or data lifecycle requirements.

  • Strong experience integrating with third-party APIs and designing for rate limits, partial failures, retries and reconciliation.

  • A strong understanding of reliability, observability, security and operational ownership.

  • Experience making architectural trade-offs and communicating technical decisions clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders.

  • A track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards.

  • The ability and desire to remain hands-on while providing technical direction to a team.

Desirable

  • Production experience with Python alongside Node.js.

  • Experience with identity and access management technologies such as Auth0, AWS Cognito or similar.

  • Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0 and authentication/authorisation patterns.

  • Experience building software within financial services or another regulated environment.

  • Experience handling data residency, retention and GDPR erasure requirements at scale.

  • Experience contributing to Architecture Review Boards or similar technical governance forums.

  • Experience establishing or improving AI-assisted software engineering practices.

The Kind of Technical Lead We’re Looking For

We’re not looking for someone who has moved completely away from engineering.

You’ll still design systems, review code, solve difficult technical problems and contribute to production software. At the same time, you’ll create leverage by helping the engineers around you make better decisions and take greater ownership.

You’ll be comfortable asking questions before reaching for a solution, thinking through failure modes as carefully as the happy path, and balancing architectural quality with the realities of delivering software in a fast-growing business.

You don’t need to have used every AWS service or technology in our stack. What matters more is that you understand the underlying engineering problems, can explain the trade-offs behind your decisions, and have successfully operated the systems you’ve helped design.

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We’ve built our business to ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and its ability to drive positive change for the future of financial services, we’d love to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet 100% of requirements, we’d like to hear from you anyway if you believe you’d fit in. Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

title: Technical Integrations Manager
description:
At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

We are looking for an experienced Technical Integrations Manager to join our Supply Integrations team and help us onboard new hotel suppliers, keep 70+ live integrations healthy, and be the technical voice our partners talk to.

Vio connects to hotel suppliers through APIs: wholesalers, bed banks, hotel chains, and connectivity platforms. The Supply Integrations squad builds and runs those integrations. You will join a second Technical Integrations Manager and a team of backend engineers, reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager. This is a hands-on technical role, not a coordination role: you own each integration in your portfolio from the first look at a partner's API documentation through implementation, QA sign-off, launch, and live operations. You decide when an integration is good enough to go live, and you are the person a partner's representative emails when something looks wrong.

What you will do:

  • Assess new partner APIs: read the documentation critically, make test calls, find the gaps and limitations before our engineers hit them, and document what we need from the partner.

  • Run technical onboarding with partners: credentials, environments, communication channels, and everything an engineer needs to start on day one.

  • Act as the single technical point of contact for both partners and engineers during implementation, answering questions and unblocking issues fast.

  • Own pre-launch quality: test search, booking, cancellation, and modification flows end to end; verify prices, availability, and tax and fee breakdowns; and sign off on go-live. No integration launches without your approval.

  • Watch the live portfolio: use dashboards and alerts to catch throttling, error spikes, and data-quality drift early, investigate, fix what is in reach (configuration, CMS, small pull requests), and work with partners on the rest.

  • Keep a per-supplier incident history, spot recurring patterns, and drive the automation and process changes that remove manual work.

  • Maintain the integrations roadmap with the Engineering Manager, Product, and Partnerships, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.

  • Continuously improve our integration lifecycle checklist based on what each launch teaches us.

Who you are:

  • You have 3+ years in a partner-facing technical role, such as technical integrations manager, integration or solutions engineer, technical account manager, or connectivity manager, and have owned a portfolio of live API integrations.

  • You are comfortable in Postman or similar software, not afraid of JSON and XML payloads, and can tell from a response what is wrong with it. Logs and dashboards are tools you reach for, not something you ask engineers to check.

  • You read API documentation critically and can assess technical viability.

  • You write clearly and briefly. A partner engineer can act on your email without a call.

  • You manage many parallel threads without dropping follow-ups and are resourceful when a partner is slow or the documentation is incomplete.

  • You improve processes rather than repeat them: you have built checklists, templates, or automation that made your previous team faster.

  • Hotel distribution experience (rate types, board codes, merchant vs agency models) is a strong plus; we will teach it to someone with the skills above.

Why join us now?

  • We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast;

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

  • We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score;

  • We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture which promotes knowledge sharing, trust and transparency;

  • A great compensation package, perks and benefits (including significant stock appreciation rights);

  • Flexible time off (take as many holidays as you need) and a chance to work remotely;

  • You will be part of a highly international team that enjoys working, eating and playing together in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam;

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden;

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins with company events in Amsterdam and abroad;

  • A budget for your dream home office;

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp.

title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $100k-$200k/yr (including equity)
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Your decisions here won't get lost in a big system. They'll define it.

As Staff Backend Engineer for Manychat for Brands, you’ll own the technical side of a new product. You’ll set the architecture and technical priorities with the team, and decide what lives in our Python services and what stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. It’s an individual contributor role with a lot of room to make an impact.

The product fills a real gap. Brands pay influencers to post but then can’t see what happens next. We’re building the first view that shows it: who asked for the link, who opened the DM, who clicked, for every campaign, creator and post.

You’ll work with Product as a partner and stay close to brands and creators, so feedback reaches you fast and helps you shape Manychat for Brands.

Sound like you? Let’s talk!

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Engineering team:

We keep Manychat running smoothly under high load every single day and make sure it's ready to scale even further. We do it by combining strong engineering foundations with AI tools that let us move faster without cutting corners. And we're the ones who shape and own what gets built. AI accelerates. Humans own the thinking.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Set the architecture and technical priorities for Brands together with the Engineering Manager and the team: service boundaries, data models, authentication, access control, and integration with the core Manychat platform.

  • Decide which logic belongs in the Python-based Brands services and which stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. Think about data ownership, reliability, and long-term maintenance.

  • Lead big system-level changes when the path isn't clear yet. Explore options, split the work into measurable milestones, and plan data migrations, gradual rollouts, and rollbacks.

  • Define reliability and performance requirements for key Brands workflows. Set metrics and observability, and check the impact of your changes on production data.

  • Find the root causes of slowdowns and repeated incidents across service boundaries, using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Work with Security, Infrastructure, and Platform teams on solutions. Decide what to fix in the application and what needs other teams, and explain the trade-offs clearly.

  • Work with Product on the approach and scope of solutions, and suggest simpler options when you see them.

  • Make technical decisions easy to follow: document key choices and the reasons behind them, do thorough design and code reviews, and share your knowledge in complex areas.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • Deep expertise in Python backend development and a broad view of backend architecture beyond one language. You can understand existing systems, even when the technology is new to you.

  • A strong product mindset. You work closely with Product Managers, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs in terms of user experience, timelines, and product capabilities.

  • Experience owning the architecture and production operations of a product or a large technical area, not only delivering separate features.

  • A solid understanding of distributed systems and data flows: API contracts, async processing, data consistency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Knowledge of how backend applications are deployed and run in production: configuration, networking, and external dependencies.

  • Knowledge of application security basics: authentication, authorization, data isolation, and access management.

  • Comfort in a fast-changing environment. Things can shift quickly here, and the team relies on everyone's proactivity and ownership.

  • Strong English for technical and product discussions and for documentation.

It would be great if you have:

  • Hands-on PHP experience, on top of understanding how our Python and PHP systems work together.

  • Experience with ETL/DWH pipelines and analytics systems.

  • Experience with environment configuration, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Experience improving AI-assisted software development practices.

Our tech stack: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery. Our services integrate with Manychat's PHP-based platform. Everything runs on AWS and Kubernetes, with Terraform/Terragrunt for infrastructure. You don't need hands-on experience with every tool. Technical depth and the ability to reason about complex systems matter most.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster.

description:
GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive.Â GTâs mission is to connect the worldâs best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of the client, GT is looking for a Senior Agentic AI Engineer who is interested in solving complex matching and search problems at scale, applying ML and algorithms to hundreds of millions of real-world data records.

Â 

About the Client

Our client is a leading global management consultancy known for tackling some of the worldâs most complex business challenges. With a focus on strategy, transformation, and performance improvement, the firm partners with major organizations across industries to drive lasting impact.

Recognized consistently as a top workplace, it combines deep industry expertise with a collaborative, innovative culture. Its centralized European hub plays a key role in supporting operations across the EMEA region, ensuring excellence and efficiency at scale.

Â 

About the Project & Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help design, build, and evolve an AI-powered conversational analytics platform that enables businesses to explore their data, generate insights and visualizations, and make data-driven decisions.

The product helps users analyze promotional performance, answer complex analytical questions, build charts and tables, and generate evidence-based recommendations using LLMs, agentic workflows, and governed client data.

The team is developing a scalable, secure, and extensible agentic AI framework that can be customized for different clients and integrated with other products through standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). The existing solution is built on LangChain, with plans to evolve and migrate the framework.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant architecture and system design component. You will work across the entire agentic AI lifecycle, from designing agent workflows, tools, and integrations to implementing evaluation frameworks, improving reliability, and delivering production-ready AI features.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and evolve agentic AI workflows for data exploration, analysis, and conversational insights.

  • Develop and improve an extensible agentic framework, including orchestration, reusable tools, skills, and conversation management.

  • Build secure integrations with application services and governed data sources, including sandboxed code execution and AI-powered data visualizations.

  • Design configurable solutions supporting client-specific prompts, tools, skills, and data definitions without duplicating the core architecture.

  • Develop MCP servers and clients to enable communication and data exchange between agents and applications.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution and migration of the existing LangChain-based solution.

  • Implement LLM evaluation, testing, observability, and security controls to ensure accurate, reliable, and data-grounded AI outputs.

  • Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation to production release and continuous improvement, collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Core Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or related fields, including 2+ years in agentic AI engineering.

  • Strong Python development skills, with experience building, testing, and maintaining production-grade applications.

  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, LangChain, or OpenAI Agents SDK.

  • Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and multi-agent or cross-application integrations.

  • Experience developing AI agents for data analysis, including dataset exploration, code generation and execution, and result interpretation.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills, including building configurable, extensible solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs.

  • Understanding of AI security, evaluation, and observability, including secure data access, LLM testing, tracing, and performance monitoring.

  • Strong ownership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with practical experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar).

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with Pydantic AI / Pydantic AI Harness and LangChain, particularly migration between frameworks.

  • Familiarity with SQL, pandas, DuckDB, or Ibis for data analysis.

  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, Docker, and analytical visualization tools such as Plotly or Dash.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with retail, pricing, promotions analytics, or similar domains.

  • Experience delivering client-facing AI products from prototype to production.

  • Familiarity with React and FastAPI.

Interview Process

  1. Interview with GT Recruiter

  2. Cultural Fit Interview

  3. Technical Interview

  4. Final Interview

  5. Offer

Why Join Our Client?

  • Join a globally recognized consulting firm building innovative AI-powered products that solve real business problems.

  • Help shape the architecture and technical direction of an evolving agentic AI platform.

  • Build production AI solutions where accuracy, data security, and reliability are essential.

  • Work with modern AI technologies and development tools, including Pydantic AI, MCP, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and product teams in an environment that encourages experimentation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership.

title: Embedded Linux Engineer (Yocto Specialist)
description:
About Genesis

Genesis is a physical AI lab and full-stack robotics company building general-purpose robots, with teams in Paris and the Bay Area. Our people have built some of the most widely used platforms in robotics research including the open-source Genesis simulator, pioneered generative simulation and led foundation-model work at some of the world's leading AI labs. We own the whole stack: hardware, embedded systems, simulation, data and robot foundation models.

The Role

Every Genesis robot runs on a custom jetson thor compute board and every piece of software we write: control, perception, learned policies, depends on the Linux image underneath it. We are looking for a senior engineer to own that image end to end: build it, ship it to the robot, keep it updatable, and make it easy for the rest of the team to compile and deploy on top of it.

This is an in-house ownership role. You will be the reference for embedded Linux at Genesis, working closely with our embedded, robotics and application-software engineers in Paris and with our hardware partners. The job is to provide a reliable, well maintained and up to date os image, customized to our needs.

What You'll Do

  • Build, own and maintain the production Yocto/OpenEmbedded distribution for our robot's custom board: BSP, kernel, device tree, rootfs, toolchain and custom layers.

  • Bring up new hardware on NVIDIA Jetson-class platforms, integrating drivers and peripherals. Including hands-on debugging of components such as Wi-Fi, cameras, audio devices and buses on the physical robot.

  • Own the full image lifecycle: reproducible builds, versioned releases, secure and robust over-the-air (OTA) updates, and long-term maintenance as hardware and software evolve.

  • Deliver a development kit and workflow (SDK, cross-compilation, deployment tooling) so engineers can build and ship their software onto the robot quickly.

  • Integrate GPU and AI-accelerator inference stacks so that our models run efficiently on the robot.

  • Speed up the team's build and CI pipeline for image generation and validation. Builds are long, so caching and automation matter, as well as removing unnecessary dependencies.

  • Document the system and make it approachable, so the image is never again a black box that only one person (or contractor) understands.

Your First Three Months

  • Build a custom Yocto image for the robot's custom boards.

  • Flash, boot and validate it on real hardware, working through driver and integration issues on-site.

  • Set up the cross compilation workflow, caching, CI automations to streamline the robotics team work

What You'll Bring

  • Passion for your craft and demonstrated excellence in embedded Linux engineering.

  • 5+ years of hands-on embedded Linux experience, including shipping at least one Yocto-based image to production not only a prototype.

  • Proven ownership of an image through its lifecycle: maintenance, release management and remote/OTA updates.

  • Deep experience with Yocto internals: layers, recipes, BitBake, machine and distro configuration, SDK generation.

  • Strong board bring-up and low-level debugging skills: kernel configuration, device trees, drivers, boot chain.

  • Hands-on experience with the NVIDIA Jetson family (JetPack / L4T, meta-tegra) or comparable embedded GPU platforms.

  • Knowledge C++ and Python packaging systems and how to deal with cross-compilation.

  • The ability to explain how your work fits into the wider build, development and deployment system.

  • Exceptional ownership and initiative, with the judgment to choose workable solutions for our current stage over the theoretically ideal one.

Bonus

  • Experience integrating GPU / AI-accelerator inference (CUDA, TensorRT or similar) on embedded targets.

  • Background in robotics, drones, connected devices or other products with custom hardware.

  • Experience working with chip vendors or ODMs.

  • Familiarity with secure boot, real-time kernel tuning (PREEMPT_RT) or OTA frameworks such as Mender, RAUC or SWUpdate.

  • French and English. Mandarin is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If You

  • Enjoy being the go-to person for a critical system and making it easier for others to use.

  • Unblock teammates' requests quickly and pragmatically, and know when "good enough to ship" is the right answer.

  • Stay patient and methodical when a single build takes two hours and a bug only shows up on hardware.

  • Like startup flexibility: changing priorities, short feedback loops and work that ranges from kernel to tooling.

title: AI Builder
description:
The short version

Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in.

As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.

What Contentoo does

Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.

None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.

There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages.

What you'll do

A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.

In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.

The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece.

What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. You'll stay hands-on, building the first versions yourself, and shape how the work grows beyond one person.

What you'll do

Set direction and own the outcome

  • Identify where agentic development can make the greatest difference, using developer feedback, existing experiments and engineering performance data.

  • Set the strategy and priorities across agent execution, repository readiness, CI, security and developer workflows.

  • Make build, buy or pass decisions on tools and vendors, and own the cost and value trade-offs, including AI spend.

Build the foundations
