  • Own the safety model: which task categories agents may attempt, what they must never touch, and where human review is required, partnering with Security on sensitive areas like auth, billing, permissions and data handling.

  • Make n8n's monorepo agent-ready, working with Architecture and senior engineers on repo structure, testability, boundaries and the context agents need.

Integrate agents into how we work

  • Build repeatable workflows that take Linear issues through agent execution, self-verification and review to merged PRs, across a growing range of task types.

  • Integrate agentic workflows with GitHub, CI, test infrastructure and code review, so the agentic path becomes the easiest path for engineers.

  • Extend the loop beyond coding: connect earlier signals like product research and customer requests, and later ones like production metrics, so agents contribute across the whole cycle.

  • Open it up beyond engineering, so PMs, designers and others can turn a well-defined issue into a reviewed, mergeable change.

  • Shape review practices, such as PR evidence that shows what changed, what ran, what risks remain and where human judgment is needed.

Measure what works

  • Build benchmarks from real historical engineering tasks to evaluate output quality, failure modes, review burden and production risk.

  • Define and track quality and adoption signals, such as reviewer acceptance rate, CI pass rate, rework rate and developer satisfaction.

  • Use data and feedback to change course, retire what doesn't work, and build trust across engineering.

  • 🤝 Direction without authority: You've set technical direction that multiple teams followed, through proposals, design reviews and credibility with senior engineers across Platform, Product Engineering, AI, Security and Architecture.

  • 🔐 Safety judgment: You've made real decisions on permissions, secrets, sandboxing, sensitive code paths and human-in-the-loop review, and can explain the trade-offs.

  • 📊 Measurement that drives decisions: You've built evaluations, benchmarks or quality metrics and used them to change course or retire things that didn't work. You care about outcomes, not lines of AI-generated code.

  • ✍️ Writing that changes decisions: Your technical proposals and documentation have shifted what teams did.

Nice-to-haves

  • 📦 TypeScript monorepos: You have worked in a large TypeScript, Node.js or JavaScript monorepo.

  • ⚙️ Developer platforms: You have experience with GitHub Actions, Linear, test infrastructure, preview environments or internal developer platforms.

  • 🏢 B2B SaaS context: You understand environments where reliability, permissions, data handling and customer trust are central.

  • 🔗 Workflow automation: You're familiar with workflow automation, integration platforms, AI orchestration or developer-facing products.

At n8n, you'll define how autonomous AI agents become a trusted part of engineering inside one of Europe's fastest-growing AI-native infrastructure companies. Your work will shape the platform foundations, safety model, evaluation framework and developer workflows that decide whether agents can contribute meaningfully to production engineering without lowering the quality bar.

You'll join a remote-first team with high autonomy, high visibility and a strong builder mindset. Because this is a first-of-its-kind role, you'll set direction, influence engineering culture, and create learnings that may inform both our internal engineering and n8n's product thinking.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now, and help us build the future of automation.

title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Founding Full-Stack Engineer

Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

  • Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

  • Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

  • Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

  • Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

  • The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.

We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.

We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

title: Website Growth Engineer
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is building the most advanced AI audio platform in the world. Millions of creators, developers, and businesses use our products, and our website is one of the company’s most important sources of new users and subscriptions.

We are looking for a Growth Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, product, data, and business. You will build and optimize the experiences that help users discover ElevenLabs, understand its value, and become active customers.

This is a highly autonomous role focused on measurable outcomes. You will identify growth opportunities, form hypotheses, build and launch experiments, analyze the results, and decide what to do next. You will work across conversion-rate optimization, organic search, programmatic pages, onboarding, web performance, and experimentation infrastructure.

Organic search and our website are major drivers of new signups and subscriptions at ElevenLabs. Engineers on this team have the opportunity to generate significant business impact through rapid experimentation, improvements to high-traffic pages, and systems that scale successful ideas across thousands or millions of search intents.

The right person is a strong product-minded engineer who enjoys moving quickly, working with data, and owning problems from initial idea through implementation and measurable impact. You should be equally comfortable analyzing a funnel, discussing an experiment with design, building the solution, and evaluating whether it worked.

What you will do

  • Identify and build opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and revenue

  • Own growth experiments from hypothesis through implementation, instrumentation, launch, analysis, and iteration

  • Build and improve high-traffic product pages, landing pages, onboarding experiences, and programmatic page systems

  • Improve technical SEO, crawlability, structured data, internal linking, page quality, and website performance

  • Collaborate with design, SEO, product, data, marketing, and frontend engineering to turn successful experiments into scalable systems

Requirements

  • Strong experience building production web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies

  • Experience independently taking projects from an initial idea through launch and measurable impact

  • Strong product judgment, with the ability to identify friction, form hypotheses, and prioritize opportunities

  • Experience working with analytics, funnels, experimentation, SQL, and product or business metrics

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy, shipping quickly, and collaborating across engineering, design, product, data, and marketing

Bonus

  • Experience working as a Growth Engineer, Product Engineer, startup founder, or early-stage engineer

  • Experience building programmatic SEO systems or scaling large numbers of landing pages

  • Experience with technical SEO, experimentation platforms, feature flags, or A/B testing

  • Experience improving onboarding, activation, monetization, referral, or sharing flows

  • A portfolio of side projects, products, automations, or experiments you have launched

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Own a major acquisition, activation, or monetization area across ElevenLabs

  • Lead the strategy and technical direction for organic growth, conversion, or experimentation

  • Build and lead a larger Growth Engineering function

  • Expand into broader product engineering or growth leadership

  • Take ownership of company-level growth metrics and cross-functional growth initiatives

Location

This role is remote and can be executed from the US East Coast or Europe, with sufficient working-hour overlap with the broader team.

You may also work from one of our offices, including London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw, and other ElevenLabs locations.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: ML Runtime Engineer
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours.
The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs — fast — on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. As we open the platform to a growing roster of defense and Earth-observation partners, the team's scope and the range of silicon we target are expanding fast.

As our ML Runtime Engineer, you'll own model compilation and the performance tooling behind it. We're looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. You'll move between model compilation, runtime internals, quantization, and hardware-in-the-loop CI, sometimes in the same afternoon.

About this role:
  • Own model compilation: turn partner ONNX models into optimized engines per accelerator (TensorRT, Hailo, AMD/ROCm), within power & thermal budgets
  • Build the ground-side compile & delivery path; define how a mismatched engine is detected/rejected on-node
  • Build performance tooling: benchmarking, profiling, operator-coverage matrices, and budget validation
  • Contribute to Space Inference Engine (execution providers) and the SDK (model build & packaging); coordinate the OBSW / Runtime team

Must Haves:
  • Strong C++ and Python
  • Model compilation: TensorRT (and/or equivalent graph compilers)
  • ONNX Runtime, quantization & inference perf optimization
  • Embedded / edge GPU deployment (NVIDIA Jetson)
  • Benchmarking & profiling / perf tooling
  • CI/CD incl. hardware-in-the-loop

Nice to Haves:
  • Hailo SDK and/or AMD ROCm compilation (iX10)
  • Writing custom kernels / operator plugins
  • Remote sensing / large-image handling 
  • RF / IQ signal data exposure
  • Meson build, Yocto / minimal Debian images
  • Model-weight protection / secure execution

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

Du profitierst von einem Marktumfeld, das deutlich stärker wächst als der klassische IT-Dienstleistungsmarkt – und von einem Unternehmen, das dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestaltet, statt nur zu verwalten.

Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile
uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum
Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine
Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit.

Klingt nach einem Traumjob? Dann jetzt Teil des Teams werden!

Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst die fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen unserer Kunden und setzt sie in Data-Engineering-Lösungen um, je nach Projekt auf Basis des SAP-Portfolios (SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Data Cloud) oder mit Databricks.

  • Du entwirfst skalierbare Lakehouse-Architekturen und entwickelst Datenplattformen, die zuverlässig, performant und wirtschaftlich nutzbar sind.

  • Du konzipierst und implementierst Datenmodelle sowie ETL-/ELT-Strecken, häufig in hybriden Szenarien, in denen SAP mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio und den gängigen Cloud-Plattformen zusammenspielt.

  • Du begleitest deine Projekte von der Anforderungsaufnahme über Konzeption und Implementierung bis zum Test und zur Übergabe in den Echtbetrieb beim Kunden.

  • Je nach Karrierestufe übernimmst du die Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder ganze Projekte und für das Windhoff Projektteam. Als Lead Consultant entwickelst du außerdem deine KollegInnen fachlich weiter.

  • Du baust unseren Databricks-Fachbereich mit auf und gestaltest unsere Multi-Vendor-Strategie mit SAP als Kern aktiv mit.

  • Durch Wissenstransfer, Projektpräsentationen und interne wie externe Technologie-Events gibst du dein Wissen an KollegInnen weiter.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast relevante Berufserfahrung im SAP Data Engineering oder mit Databricks, zum Beispiel als SAP Data Engineer, SAP BW Consultant, SAP Datasphere Consultant oder Data Engineer.

  • Du kennst dich mit SAP Datasphere und dem Databricks Lakehouse aus, beherrschst SQL-Script und Python sicher und hast ETL-/ELT-Prozesse bereits erfolgreich umgesetzt.

  • Erfahrung mit Delta Lake, der Medallion-Architektur und Databricks Workflows ist von Vorteil.

  • Hierfür sind auch verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (C1-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2-Niveau) erforderlich.

Deine Perspektive

Bei uns steigst du auf der Stufe ein, die zu deiner Erfahrung passt. Von dort aus entwickelst du dich weiter:

  • Als Consultant arbeitest du in unseren Projektteams mit und verantwortest eigene Arbeitspakete. So lernst du die Data-Engineering-Welt rund um SAP und Databricks in echten Kundenprojekten kennen.

title: Sales Manager - Buy Side
description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🎙️ The Role

We're hiring a Buy Side Originator to join the Commercial team in our Buy engine.

tem lets businesses buy renewable energy directly from the generators that produce it - transparent pricing, fair terms, no middlemen. Demand from smaller businesses is growing fast, and we need someone to own it.

You will run a high-velocity sales motion end-to-end: qualify, progress, close, and hand off cleanly. You'll work directly with business customers buying energy through tem, backed by a CRM and AI-assisted outreach tooling that keeps your pipeline full while you focus on the conversations that close deals.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Close your first SMB deals within your opening weeks, working a live pipeline from day one.

  • Own the long tail of a fast-growing SMB pipeline, keeping deals moving instead of going stale.

  • Put signed volume on the board that counts directly towards the Buy engine's goals.

  • Sharpen our SMB playbook with front-line feedback on what buyers ask and where deals stick.

  • Grow towards owning bigger slices of the origination motion.

🚀 Responsibilities

  • Close with pace: own smaller direct SMB opportunities from first contact to signature, keeping momentum with clear next steps.

  • Qualify fast: run discovery calls to understand each customer's site, contract timing and usage, and triage leads into chase, nurture or drop.

  • Sell honestly: explain the tem proposition clearly, handle the objections SMBs actually raise, and walk away when a deal isn't right for the customer.

  • Keep it clean: maintain tight CRM hygiene - notes, stages and timelines always current - so nothing slips and handoffs into onboarding are smooth.

  • Work smart: use AI and outreach tooling to cover more pipeline than a traditional rep could, without losing judgement on the calls that matter.

  • Feed the loop: share what customers are asking for and where deals get stuck, so the proposition keeps improving.

🎯 Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Experience in direct B2B sales where you owned deals end-to-end, qualify to close.

  • Comfortable speaking with customers every day and working a high-volume pipeline without letting deals go stale.

  • Strong discovery and objection-handling instincts - you can explain a cost-savings proposition to a non-technical buyer.

  • Disciplined CRM habits: clear notes, accurate stages, honest reporting.

  • Low ego, direct and coachable - honest with customers even when it costs the deal.

Desirable

  • Experience selling into SMBs in energy, utilities or another price-sensitive market.

  • Familiarity with sales automation and AI-assisted outreach tooling.

  • Experience running renewal or retention motions alongside new business.

✨ Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to £1,200 or €1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to £150 or €150 per month for wellbeing.

🗣️ Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager (30 mins).

  • Technical Interview with the Team (45 - 60 mins). You'll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss how you run a high-velocity sales motion - discovery, qualification, objection handling and closing - including a practical exercise.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with a leader in the business.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - Ads Engine
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We build an ads engine that learns as it goes: brand book, taste, and what actually performs in every market. It plans, generates, localizes, launches and learns from ads across the major ad platforms, using ElevenLabs’ full audio and video stack.
You’ll be a founding engineer for a product area of your own. There’s no PM and no handed-down spec. You’ll talk to users, decide what to build, and ship it across the stack, from data pipelines and agent tools to the UI. Early work could include feeding competitive intelligence into the engine’s weekly briefs or launching a new ad format.
We’re looking for founders and founding engineers. You’d rather ship a rough v0 on Friday than a perfect design doc. Strong engineering is the minimum. What sets people apart is product judgment and ownership.

Requirements

  • Has built and shipped a product end-to-end without anyone handing them a spec, ideally as a founder or one of the first engineers.

  • Strong full-stack product engineer (frontend- or backend-leaning is fine) who can build a pipeline, an agent tool and the UI

  • Builds with LLMs and agents pragmatically: tools, retrieval and evals, not model research.

  • Talks to users without being asked, and can say what they’d build first and why.

Bonus: experience with ad platforms, adtech or marketing tools; analytics and attribution; web builders and CMSs; taste in creative.

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere between the US East Coast and India, with the ability to operate in European timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

Benefits

title: Strategic Account Executive Enterprise - DACH
description:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
  • A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
  • A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
  • Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
  • A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here!
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

The Mission 🪐
  • The Situation: Malt is cementing its position as the undeniable leader in the European freelance economy. While our tech-powered platform connects over 1,000,000 top-tier freelancers with 100,000+ companies, the DACH Enterprise sector presents a massive, untapped frontier. This market is dominated by complex, multinational corporate structures with deeply entrenched procurement protocols that are ripe for disruption.
  • The Task: We are not hiring you to manage an existing portfolio or farm warm leads. You are being brought in to architect and own the zero-to-one enterprise acquisition strategy for the DACH region. Operating as the "founder" of your territory, your mandate is to systematically penetrate massive global accounts, navigate labyrinthine procurement structures, and secure highly scalable, multi-country Master Service Agreements (MSAs) that will cement Malt's dominance in the German-speaking market and beyond.

    • Key Responsibilities ✨

    Pillar 1: Strategic Territory Architecture & Hunting

  • Action: Map out complex, global enterprise accounts within the DACH region, aggressively designing and executing surgical prospecting strategies to breach heavily fortified multi-stakeholder environments (Procurement, HR, and independent Business Units).
  • Output: A localized, highly qualified pipeline of net-new DACH Enterprise logos and concrete, multi-threaded stakeholder maps.
  • Metrics of Performance: Enterprise GSV Pipeline Generated and CRM forecast integrity.

    • Pillar 2: Deal Orchestration & RFP Command

  • Action: Run rigorous, in-depth discovery utilizing the full MEDDIC framework to validate severe business pain, identify the true Economic Buyer, and aggressively lead end-to-end RFI/RFP processes alongside our Bid Management and technical teams.
  • Output: Compelling, ROI-driven business proposals and precisely engineered enterprise pilot programs designed to prove undeniable platform value.
  • Metrics of Performance: RFI/RFP Win Rate and Pilot-to-MSA Conversion Rate.

    • Pillar 3: Heavy-Weight Negotiation & Scalable Revenue Activation

  • Action: Command ruthless, complex negotiations for global Master Service Agreements involving tight friction with Legal, Finance, and Procurement across multiple countries. Upon signature, engineer the scalable handover strategy to the local Account Management teams.
  • Output: Executed, multi-country MSAs and comprehensive post-signature deployment kickoff plans.
  • Metrics of Performance: Total Contract Value (TCV) Signed and Deal Velocity (managing complex cycles efficiently without losing momentum).

    • Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍

    Proven Mastery (What you have already built):

  • A minimum of 8 years of quantifiable, proven track record hunting and closing complex, 7-figure B2B sales cycles within a SaaS/Tech environment.
  • Deep familiarity with the staffing, "future of work" industry, MSPs, or Tier 1 recruitment groups.
  • Demonstrated success navigating extremely long sales cycles and managing strategic concessions to close highly scalable deals.
  • Native-level fluency in German and full professional fluency in English.

    • Skills You Will Deploy & Develop:

  • Advanced MEDDIC Mastery: You will deploy this framework with such rigor that you act as the internal benchmark and can actively coach others on its nuances.
  • C-Suite ROI Narrative Construction: Mastering the art of delivering disruptive narratives that challenge legacy customer assumptions and shift C-level perspectives on the "Future of Work."
  • Cross-Border Deal Structuring: Developing top-tier acumen in multi-country legal, financial, and compliance orchestration.

    • The Self-Selection Filter ❓

    This role is perfect for you if:

  • You are an elite hunter who actively enjoys the strategic friction of a complex enterprise sales cycle and navigating massive corporate red tape.
  • You operate with extreme ownership—you treat your pipeline like your own startup's P&L and do not wait for permission or inbound leads to execute.
  • You naturally think in terms of "Economic Buyers," "Decision Criteria," and "Validation Events" rather than just "having good meetings."

    • This role is NOT for you if:

  • You rely heavily on inbound marketing or a pre-packaged SDR playbook to hit your pipeline numbers.
  • You get easily intimidated by heavy-weight legal negotiations, aggressive procurement teams, or highly structured RFP processes.
  • You prefer predictable, transactional account maintenance over the high-stakes thrill of net-new, multi-country enterprise acquisition.

    • 30-60-90 Day Impact Plan 🏁
  • Day 30: Submerge into our marketplace mechanics, master the Malt value proposition, and map the top tier of DACH global enterprise accounts. Output: Delivery of your fully architected account penetration strategy.
  • Day 60: Execute initial outreach, identify key Economic Buyers within target accounts, and begin orchestrating your first high-stakes pilot phases. Output: Establish a predictable, MEDDIC-qualified enterprise pipeline.
  • Day 90: Take absolute control of your Metrics of Performance. Lead your first complex RFI/RFP processes or MSA negotiations end-to-end and initiate scalable handover plans. Output: Secure early enterprise traction that directly impacts the regional bottom line.

    • How to join the mission? 🚀
  • First Call (45m): High-level alignment with Niko (Talent Acquisition Lead) to audit your background and entrepreneurial drive.
  • Strategic Deep Dive (60m): Interview with your future manager, Théo, to dissect your past enterprise deals and MEDDIC rigor.
  • Business Case (60m): A live simulation to assess your technical account development, localized prospecting skills, and C-level narrative delivery.
  • Final Vision Call (30m): Interview with our CRO to discuss Malt’s long-term scale and how your ambition aligns with our macro-economic growth.
    • Life on planet Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
     
    🤝 Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other onboardees at our office in Paris.
    💻 Remote work: Hybrid remote policy - 3 days office / 2 days home-office.
    🏖️ Annual leave: 30 days/year.
    📆 Sabbatical: 1 month paid sabbatical once you've been with Malt for 3 years.
    📈 Stock options: Every Malter is entitled to stock options. 
    🍽️ Lunch vouchers: 6,50€ per day / 15 days a month.
    🐶 Dog friendly office: In the heart of Munich/Berlin!
    ❓ Choose your Benefit: Transport reimbursement, Gym membership, Organic Food voucher or Rydes Mobility App.
    📚 Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow.
     
    Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 
     
    At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive.

title: AI Software Engineer (Forward Deployment Engineer)
description:
About Agicap


Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !


Agicap est en train de devenir une AI-first company. Nous formons l'ensemble de nos employés à travailler avec l'IA et à automatiser eux-mêmes une partie de leurs tâches. Certains projets sont trop longs, trop transverses ou trop techniques pour être portés par une équipe métier seule.

C'est le rôle de l'AI Lab.

C'est l'équipe pivot qui construit les outils internes qui changent la façon dont Agicap travaille au quotidien. Notre boussole : impact opérationnel rapide, itérations courtes, travail à 360° avec toutes les équipes (Sales, CS, Finance, Produit, Marketing, Data, C-level).

C'est une création de poste : l'accélération de l'IA change nos process et notre manière de bosser. On a besoin d'un renfort senior pour accompagner cette transition et l'inscrire dans des pratiques qui tiennent sur le long terme.

L'équipe que tu vas rejoindre : 
  • 4 personnes, toi inclus : un ingénieur IA junior, un Tech Lead à mi-temps (qui sera ton manager), un Product Manager.
  • Ton rôle : apporter le recul technique qui manque aujourd'hui dans l'équipe (infra, architecture, maintenabilité, scalabilité) — construire vite, mais sans creuser de dette pour demain.
  • Tu es en interaction directe avec toutes les équipes métier d'Agicap : c'est un poste très transverse, très exposé.

⚡️ Responsabilités :

Tu alternes entre cadrage rapide, build et itération :

  • Comprendre le besoin d'une équipe métier en direct, cadrer ce qui a réellement de l'impact vs. ce qui est du confort, prioriser.
  • Construire les outils internes de bout en bout : cadrage → dev → mise en prod → itération avec les utilisateurs.
  • Faire évoluer la plateforme IA commune : serveurs MCP, intégrations, outillage transverse mis à disposition de toute l'entreprise.
  • Prendre les décisions techniques qui structurent le Lab : infra, choix de stack, architecture. Il n'y a pas d'existant lourd auquel te conformer, tu construis pour scaler.
  • Élever le niveau technique de l'équipe : mentoring de l'IA Engineer junior, transmission des bonnes pratiques, revue de code utile.
  • Identifier proactivement les process où l'IA apporte un vrai gain — et construire la solution.

    • Exemples de chantiers sur tes 6 premiers mois :

    • Feedback loop produit : construire un système qui digère l'ensemble des logs de feedback client (calls, RFP, remontées CS) et produit des recommandations priorisées pour les Product Managers. Aujourd'hui la donnée existe mais on ne la digère pas.
    • Chantier infra MCP : mettre à disposition des collaborateurs Agicap des serveurs MCP connectés à leurs outils du quotidien, à l'échelle.

⚡️Comment on travaille :
  • Autonomie totale : équipe de 3, tu décides, tu assumes tes choix.
  • Ship rate élevé : on livre quotidiennement, on mesure, on itère. 
  • IA au quotidien dans le delivery : on utilise Claude, OpenAI, Mistral au quotidien pour construire — on n'observe pas la vague IA, on est dedans.
  • Anglais requis : beaucoup de collaborateurs sont anglophones. Ton binôme est francophone.

    • 👀 Le profil recherché:

    On vise un profil senior avec expérience de Tech Lead — quelqu'un qui a déjà pris des décisions impactantes, poussé des sujets techniques exigeants, et exploré activement le terrain IA :

    • ~4-5 ans d'expérience minimum en dev, sur des projets réellement mis en production.
    • Expérience de Tech Lead ou équivalent : tu as déjà drivé des décisions d'architecture et d'infra, tu sais arbitrer entre vélocité et dette.
    • Pratique concrète et récente des LLMs : tu as essayé des choses, poussé des expérimentations, testé Claude / OpenAI / Mistral. Tu es moteur sur ces sujets, pas suiveur.
    • Python et TypeScript dans ta boîte à outils. Le langage compte moins que ta capacité à choisir le bon outil pour le bon problème.
    • Bases techniques solides : tu maîtrises et comprends ce que tu livres.
    • Capacité à livrer vite et à prioriser ce qui a réellement de l'impact — mode Doer, pas mode powerpoint.
    • Proactivité et curiosité : tu identifies des opportunités que personne n'a formulées, tu vas chercher.
    • Anglais professionnel courant.
    • Autonomie assumée : dans une équipe de 3, tu ne peux pas te cacher. 

    ⭐ Stack et outillage
  • LLMs : Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI, Mistral — l'équipe n'est pas mono-provider, tu choisis le bon modèle pour le bon usage.
  • Langages : majoritairement Python et TypeScript.
  • Infra : à toi de la construire, avec un vrai droit de décision — pas d'existant lourd.
  • Outillage IA en interne : serveurs MCP, plateforme IA commune, agents connectés aux outils métier.
  • Cycle : Continuous Delivery, mise en prod quotidienne, feedback utilisateur direct.

    • 🎁 Ce qu'on offre
    • Un poste à impact direct et visible dans une AI-first company de 600 personnes.
    • Un cadre ultra-responsabilisant : autonomie, ownership, décisions techniques à ton niveau.
    • Rémunération : 55K€ - 70K€ selon expertise + prime vacances SYNTEC.
    • CDI, forfait en heures, 39h dont 4h supplémentaires payées.
    • 25 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de congés flexibles (utilisables dès l'arrivée).
    • Localisation : Notre siège de Lyon ou possibilité de Full-Remote.
    • Mutuelle Alan (extension famille possible), titres restaurant Swile (11€/jour dont 6,50€ pris en charge).
    • Avantages CSE : carte KDO annuelle, Gymlib/EGYM wellpass, etc.
    • Démarrage ASAP.

    ⏳ Process de recrutement :
    1. Screening avec l'équipe Talent Acquisition — présentation du poste et validation du fit (30-45 min).
    2. Deux entretiens techniques avec l'équipe AI Lab (formats et sujets communiqués en amont). 

    Feedback sous 24-48h à chaque étape. Process rapide, transparent.

    Agicap s'engage à garantir l'égalité des chances pour tous et favorise un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité !

title: Langfuse - Senior Product Engineer
description:
Why Product Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. Langfuse has 35,000+ GitHub stars and our SDKs are downloaded more than a hundred million times per month. When you ship a new feature the community notices in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community channels.

Product engineers at Langfuse are the people who deliver new features end-to-end to our users. You own the product thinking from understanding the user problem to deciding what to build to shipping the solution.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers leveraging Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible product and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Own features end-to-end: from talking to users, to writing the spec, to shipping the code and docs, to writing the changelog post with your name on it. To give you a sense: recent features a single engineer owned include the Langfuse for Agents release (new trace views, agent graphs, semantic span labels), the TypeScript SDK v4 rewrite on OpenTelemetry, and managing dashboards via API/CLI/MCP.

  • Work across the full stack: and we mean full. Our surface area is wide: React frontend, Next.js backend, ClickHouse analytics, Python and TypeScript SDKs, public docs, Terraform modules, and more. You'll touch whatever the feature needs. One week you might be writing a new ClickHouse query for cost analytics, the next you're designing an SDK API, the next you're building a new rust worker for faster data processing.

  • Talk to users constantly: jump on calls, respond in community channels, and route support requests. At Langfuse, support is how we build conviction about what to build next. Our handbook says it best: support by engineers is a core value proposition.

  • Write public documentation about the features you own. At Langfuse, docs are product.

  • Ship publicly during Launch Weeks: we've run four Launch Weeks so far, dropping a new feature every day for a week. Engineers present the features they built to the community.

 

What we’re looking for

  • Someone who has built features or even entire products from scratch end-to-end

  • Experience building and shipping user-facing products end-to-end, ideally in TypeScript/React and with exposure to data-intensive backends

  • Someone who can manage projects themselves. You know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it.

  • Taste for great developer experience: you care about API design, UI details, and clear documentation

  • Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their problems

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

  • CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

  • Experience with ClickHouse, analytics databases, or building complex data visualizations

  • Former founder or early startup experience

  • Contributions to popular open source projects

  • ML/AI background or familiarity with the LLM framework ecosystem

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

title: Staff Product Engineer - AI Native
description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? 

Vision: 

As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026. 

Our Impact: 

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East. 

Our Recognition: 

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019. 

The Role:

Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite.

We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite. 

We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience. 

Missions

  • Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after.
  • Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration.
  • Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change.
  • Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine".
  • Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention.
  • Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive.
  • Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification.
  • Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing.

Requirements

Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English.

Experience & Seniority:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
  • Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products
  • Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead

AI-Native Practice:

  • Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability
  • A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate
  • Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain

Verification & Quality:

  • Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code
  • Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have
  • Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced?

Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role):

  • Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed
  • Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop
  • Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production

Product & Team Collaboration:

  • Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead
  • Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup
  • Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why

Education:

  • Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments

What this role is not

We would rather say it up front:

  • It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role.
  • It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one.
  • It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Node.js / TypeScript
  • Frontend: Vue.js 3
  • Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
  • DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • Cloud: GCP

Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing.

What we offer

  • Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai;
  • Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";
  • Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process

  • Interview with a TA team member (30/45 mins)
  • Interview with the Engineering Manager (1h)
  • Technical interview (1h30) — two parts: turning an ambiguous requirement into a specification with executable acceptance criteria, then an adversarial review of an agent-generated diff against that specification
  • Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.

You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

  • Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals — and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.

  • Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.

  • Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.

  • Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.

  • Experience with ClickHouse, other OLAP databases, or observability infrastructure

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Germany.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems.
You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance.
Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.
You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results.
You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes.
Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions.
As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops.

  • Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability.

  • Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes.

  • Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices.

  • Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment.

  • Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention.

  • Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities.

  • Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively.

  • Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes.

  • Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems.

  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

    • Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment.

    • Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments.

    • Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability.

    • Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops.

    • Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems.

    • Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering.

    • Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs.

    • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges.

    • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment.

    • High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations.

    • Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes.

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English.

    • Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive Compensation: Annual salary ranging from €100,000 to €150,000.

      • Remote Work: Opportunity to work remotely within Europe or the United Kingdom.

      • Early-Team Influence: Join as an early core engineering team member with significant ownership over technical direction and architectural decisions.

      • Technical Autonomy: Shape engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and the foundations of the organization's agentic AI infrastructure.

      • Cutting-Edge Technology: Work extensively with advanced LLMs, autonomous agents, multi-agent architectures, and AI-powered software development workflows.

      • Meaningful Impact: Build production systems that address real operational challenges and deliver measurable business value.

      • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product and operational teams to identify opportunities and develop practical automation solutions.
