  • 6 months. By the end of the first semester, you have a firm understanding of Quandela’s technology and are already a key contributor to the compiler codebase for the near future
  • 12 months. You have a long-term vision over the quantum software’s activities, and are the owner of one or more work packages for strategic projects.

Requirements

What we're looking for: 

  • Master’s, or PhD in Quantum related field.
  • 2/4+ years of relevant experience in quantum software, quantum hardware automation, or related topics.

Must-have: 

  • A good understanding of photonic-based quantum computing.
  • Strong proficiency in python.
  • Experience working at the interface of software, experimental hardware, and theory teams in the industry or academia.
  • Collaborative mindset, able to serve as a bridge between various teams.

Important, but you can grow here: 

  • Proficiency in at least one system language (C++ or Rust)
  • Exposure to the quantum computing frontends and related ecosystem (e.g. cirq, qiskit, openqasm, cuda-q).
  • Hands-on experience with quantum photonic systems.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

  • Hiring Managers Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 to 3 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

description:
Turn new revenue opportunities into products construction companies pay for.


Your mission

Cosuno is the marketplace where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, and subcontractors find and win new projects. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

We see several ways to grow from here, such as new modules for existing customers or customer segments we don't serve yet. As our Senior PM for Growth, you'll own one of these opportunities and you'll help choose the next. Next to that, you'll take care of the day-to-day product work in your area.

What you'll do

  • Find the real problem. Talk to customers, many of whom aren't tech-savvy, dig into our data and work out who has the problem, how much it matters and what we need to build.

  • Put AI to work. Construction still runs on a lot of manual work. You'll find where AI can replace it and turn that into products customers love.

  • Test before you build. Prototype and run small experiments with real customers before Engineering commits, then ship with Design and Engineering.

  • Bring it to market. Launch with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, from positioning and pricing to enablement, and measure what it brings in.

After one year, you've taken your first opportunity to real customers, you're working on your second, and the new offerings bring in measurable revenue.

How we work

  • Full ownership. You own your growth opportunity end to end, from the first customer conversation to the revenue it brings in. Design and Engineering build with you.

  • Close to the customer. You'll talk to customers constantly.

  • Fast and data-driven. We ship every two weeks, test ideas before we build them and judge every launch by its numbers.

  • AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day. For every opportunity, your first question is: where can AI take manual work off our customers' hands?

What you bring

  • 3–5 years as a product manager in B2B SaaS, and you want to stay hands-on

  • You've taken a new revenue opportunity (a module, upsell, segment or market) from idea to a product customers pay for

  • You've shipped AI features that customers actually use, and you use AI tools every day in your own work

  • You work with numbers and experiments, and you change course when the data says so

  • You explain complex things simply, to a site manager as well as to management

  • German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our engineering team in English

Why us?

  • Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

title: Founding Engineer (Remote or Hybrid - EEA/UK)
description:
Founding Engineer


Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices.

Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us.

About Tarebase

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.

Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.

Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on.

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.

You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes.

You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship.

You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. You know how to build agents and AI workflows into a product and use evaluations, validation and deterministic logic to make what they produce consistent and verifiable. You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up.

You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. We work remotely, so clear communication and follow-through matter a lot to us. We value people who manage their own work, can be counted on, and raise important issues early.

How to apply

Apply with the button on this page.

Please ensure to use a hand-written CV. We read every application ourselves. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice.

Our process

The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability.

  1. Application review. If we love your resume we will send over some short questions.

  2. Intro call with Dom and Felix. An informal conversation about the role, the technology and what you're looking for.

  3. Technical deep dive with Felix. We talk briefly about a system you’ve worked on (no need to share anything confidential), then work through a system design problem together.

  4. Half a day with us in Munich or London. We cover your travel, hotel if needed, and meals. You spend about two hours on a made-up task similar to the problems we work on, using your usual tools and coding agents. Then we have lunch, go through your work together, and talk through a customer scenario.

  5. References and offer. We speak with 1-2 people you've worked with (only with your agreement) and aim to decide within 48 hours.

If we don't move forward after the technical conversation or later, we'll share some feedback with you.

Compensation: €100.000–120.000 base salary plus 0.75–1% equity

Setup: A MacBook Pro and whatever else you need to work well. If you'd rather not work from home, we'll pay for a coworking space near you.

Location: Munich or London, or remote within Europe (GMT-1 to GMT+3) with regular meet-ups.


Candidate privacy policy available here: https://tarebase.com/candidate-privacy

title: Senior AWS Platform Engineer
description:
At Luscii, we are creating space for care by building digital health applications that help people manage their health. Applications such as the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps users receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on our products every month, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is a cloud platform that simply works. As engineer working on our apps, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers the platform, creating a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

OMRON Connect is one of the largest digital health platforms in our ecosystem, connecting millions of users with their healthcare data through OMRON devices. Much of the platform has grown over many years and was partly built by external partners. Today, we're investing heavily in bringing that knowledge, ownership and technical excellence in-house. This is not about replacing everything overnight. It is about making thoughtful engineering decisions, modernising step by step, and building a cloud platform that gives our engineering teams the foundations, tooling and confidence they need to deliver safely and independently.

Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it.

Your role

You will become one of the technical driving forces behind the cloud platforms that power our digital health applications. Working closely with fellow engineers, product teams and colleagues across countries, you will help shape and improve our cloud infrastructure, strengthen the developer experience and ensure reliability, security and scalability are built into the foundations of our technology. Your exact focus will evolve with the needs of our teams and the opportunities you identify to make a lasting impact.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems without chasing complexity for complexity's sake. You will help us balance innovation with pragmatism, modernising a live healthcare platform while maintaining the stability that patients and healthcare professionals depend on every day.

What you will be doing, among others:

  • Design, build and evolve our AWS platform using Terraform as the single source of truth, while driving the gradual modernisation of our cloud landscape;

  • Build reusable infrastructure, deployment pipelines and platform tooling that enable engineering teams to ship independently and safely;

  • Introduce pragmatic cloud-native and event-driven solutions where they genuinely improve scalability, reliability and maintainability;

  • Make observability a default through standardised monitoring, logging, dashboards and alerting across the platform;

  • Improve deployment practices with automated CI/CD, progressive delivery and reliable rollback strategies;

  • Embed security, compliance and cost optimisation into the platform through automated guardrails and best practices;

  • Coach fellow engineers, review infrastructure and application code, and raise the overall cloud engineering bar through collaboration and example.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: Naturally, this depends on your background, experience, and relevant expertise. You may think of a maximum salary of approximately €86.000,- to €94.000,- per year for this position.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale cloud platforms, with deep hands-on AWS expertise and including the same amount of experience in senior-level ownership of modern cloud architectures;

  • You have extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and treat infrastructure with the same rigour as application code;

  • You have a strong understanding of cloud-native, serverless and event-driven architectures, and the judgement to apply them pragmatically;

  • You know how to build reliable production systems with observability, automated deployments and safe release practices built in;

  • You enjoy modernising legacy platforms through incremental improvements rather than big-bang rewrites, while bringing others along in the process;

  • You have strong backend engineering experience, preferably with Node.js and TypeScript;

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

A very strong senior software engineer with deep, hands-on experience building and operating production systems. We hire for engineering strength first: people who write good software, reason about failure, and own what they ship.

  • Depth — you can explain the systems you built and the trade-offs you chose

  • Learns new domains quickly and deliberately

Interview Process

  1. Introductory call - 30 minutes

title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
description:
About Stream

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on.

This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on

Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities:

  • Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

  • Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

  • Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

  • Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

  • Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

  • Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

About you

You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you.

You have:

  • Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems

  • Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java)

  • A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale

  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost

  • Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS

  • Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on

  • Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production

Bonus points:

  • Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack

  • Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud

  • Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1)

  • CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale

  • Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies

  • Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products

  • Python or Rust alongside Go

  • Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media

What makes this role exciting

  • Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships.

  • Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company.

  • Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use.

  • Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached.

Why join Stream?

We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here.

What we offer

  • Company equity

  • 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays

  • Pension plan with a company contribution

  • NS Business Card or a company bike, covered

  • Personal development budget of EUR 500 per year

  • Catered lunches in the office

  • MacBook Pro

  • Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice

  • Highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're moving to Amsterdam

This list applies to Netherlands-based employees and is adjusted to your location of residence. If you work remotely from another EU country, you'll be employed through our Employer of Record partner and get company equity plus local benefits depending on your country of employment.

Our culture

Stream is a casual, transparent team that aims high and supports each other. In engineering, we care about ownership and quality, and our goal is to ship stable software. Management stays hands-on, with less middle management and more time spent doing the work. If that sounds like the environment you want next, apply now.

We hire on skills and experience, and we don't discriminate based on age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, political opinion, disability or chronic illness, marital status, working hours, type of contract, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an adjustment at any point in our hiring process, let us know.

title: Founding Growth - Alan Precision
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Alan Precision: why this exists

Your body knows before you do. The signals are there years before symptoms. And yet, in 2026, the system around us isn't catching them.

50% of non-communicable diseases (cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, many cancers) are preventable with lifestyle changes, and we're not capturing them. Western countries have seen healthspan flatline for years, meaning we live longer, but not better. 46% of Europeans report mental health issues. The kind of deep, personalised health reading that could change this has been reserved for the few who could afford a 3,000€ check-up, and built for filing reports rather than changing lives.

We don't accept that.

Alan Precision is our bet on advanced prevention as the new norm of care. We combine biology, wearables, medical history, and lifestyle context, read it all as a connected system with AI supervised by physicians, and turn the result into a personalised protocol the member actually executes across sleep, nutrition, movement, stress, and supplementation. Then we retest, learn, and adapt. Health is a moving target. We move with it.

Our ambition: make Alan Precision the reference for advanced prevention in Europe by 2030.

⭐ The Founding Growth opportunity

Alan Precision is live, with fast week-over-week growth. Now we need to turn a new category into a habit: hundreds of thousands of customers in the coming years, and a measurable impact on their health. You will be the first growth and go-to-market person on the crew, accountable for two numbers: how many members subscribe to Precision, and how many stay, retest and renew.

The crew was launched by the founding team of ARO, acquired by Alan in 2026, to move fast and apply their learnings from building a preventive health company.

It is a unique playground. You get the means of one of France's biggest scale-ups (1M+ members reachable from day one, an ecosystem of products like Mo, Play and Clinic, and a brand carried by ambassadors like Kylian Mbappé) with the culture and pace of a fast-growing startup: small crew, short loops, everything still to invent.

🔭 Scope: Three go-to-market engines

1. Direct-to-member: turn Alan's 1M+ members into Precision subscribers.

Offering paid services that members subscribe to by themselves inside Alan is a pretty new go-to-market for us, and you invent it.

  • Build the CRM and lifecycle engine: segments, triggers, sequences, in-app moments.

  • Use product data to decide who to push Precision to, when and where: which actions, traits or life moments make it relevant, and which do not.

  • Position Precision inside the surfaces of other product crews (Mo, Play, Clinic, Shop), with their teams and push the right message at the right time.

  • Own recurrence: activation after the first check-up, retests, renewals, reactivation. Acquisition without retention does not count.

2. B2B: get Alan's client companies to offer Precision to their employees.

Almost everything is to define: business model, offer format, pricing logic, sales motion.

  • Work with our B2B Marketing team to understand the constraints of our Sales and Account Management teams, give them the right pitch and materials, and set the right targets with them.

  • Meet HR buyers yourself to learn what makes them pay.

3. Beyond Alan: take Precision to the open market.

Once the internal engine runs:

  • Apply the full B2C health and e-commerce playbook to acquire users that are not insured by Alan

  • Your levers will be numerous, across paid acquisition, influence, partnerships, brand.

Across all three:

  • Create demand in a market that is still being created. Talk to members every week, define the value proposition and the messages that make people want advanced prevention, and push for the product changes that go with them.

  • Build a brand people want, and explain it simply. Make advanced prevention desirable and easy to understand, with our Brand team, without overpromising.

  • Say what can be said. Health communication is regulated: medical biology, health claims, influencer rules, use of health data for targeting. You work with our medical and legal teams and turn these constraints into sharper, more credible messages.

  • Measure and decide. Funnels, cohorts, holdouts, channel performance. Pick the next bet, cut what does not work, share what we learned.

  • Own it end to end. From the idea of a strategy to the campaign live in production: you design it, write it, build it, ship it and iterate on it yourself. Sharp copywriting is a core part of the job.

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

  • Fluent in French and English.

  • You have grown a B2C product from its early days. Ideally as the first growth or go-to-market person, on a subscription in health, wellbeing or e-commerce. You can tell us which channels you picked, which ones you cut, and why.

  • A creative Swiss army knife who prioritises. You can do a bit of everything and you find channels and angles nobody has thought of yet. You know the job is to pick the right one, execute it, measure it and move to the next.

  • Lifecycle and CRM at scale. Customer.io, Braze or equivalent: segmentation, behavioural triggers, in-app moments.

  • Analytical rigour. You read a funnel, build a cohort, set up a holdout and call a result. You measure success in subscribers, retention and revenue.

  • Hands-on, and a great writer. You love taking an idea all the way to production yourself: the strategy, the copy, the campaign, the dashboard. You write well and fast, and you turn a complex medical topic into a clear, desirable promise.

  • Customer-obsessed. You talk to members every week and you are just as comfortable in front of an HR director.

  • Fluent with AI. You build with AI every day: assets, copy variants, segments, analyses and even building your own tools. You use it to go faster, and you keep your judgment on what ships.

  • Driven by health, and rigorous about it. Health matters to you, and when something blocks, you find a way. You make people want to act with messages that hold up in front of a physician.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with regulated health communication (claims, health data, medical services).

  • B2B2C, employee benefits or HR tech.

  • Paid acquisition and influencer marketing in B2C.

  • Pricing and packaging of subscription offers.

  • You own your own health: Whoop, Oura, blood tests, supplements are no secret for you.

🌍 How we work

  • Location: Paris

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.
If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?
Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

title: UX/UI Designer (m/w/d) mit Projektverantwortung
description:
Über die Rolle

Du gestaltest digitale Produkte für Web und Mobile, die Menschen wirklich verstehen und gern benutzen?

Und du willst nicht nur Screens liefern, sondern Verantwortung für das Ergebnis übernehmen, vom ersten Nutzerinterview bis zum Release?

Wir entwickeln Software für die Diagnostik, unter anderem Apps, die Schnelltests per Smartphone-Kamera auswerten, und die dazugehörigen Webportale. Als UX/UI Designer (m/w/d) mit Projektverantwortung gestaltest du diese Produkte, führst deine Designprojekte selbst und bist Ansprechperson für unsere Partner, wenn es um Nutzererlebnis geht.

Deine Aufgaben

UI/UX Design:

  • Du gestaltest Web-Anwendungen (Portale, Dashboards) und Mobile Apps für Android und iOS

  • Du führst Nutzerforschung durch und entwickelst User Flows, Wireframes, Prototypen und finale Designs

  • Du pflegst und erweiterst unser Designsystem

  • Du arbeitest eng mit der Entwicklung von der Idee bis zum Release zusammen

Projektverantwortung und Kommunikation:

  • Du führst deine Projekte: Ziele, Zeitplan, Abstimmung und Ergebnis

  • Du stellst Konzepte und Designs bei Partnern vor und holst Feedback ein

  • Du schreibst User Stories mit klaren Akzeptanzkriterien und pflegst Roadmap und Prioritäten gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkollegen aus der Entwicklung und Geschäftsführung

Qualität:

  • Du testest neue Funktionen gegen das Design und die Akzeptanzkriterien und wirkst an Usability-Evaluationen mit

Was du mitbringst

Design:

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im UX/UI Design

  • Ein Portfolio mit umgesetzten Web- und Mobile-Projekten

  • Sehr sicherer Umgang mit einem professionellen UI-Design-Tool, inklusive Komponenten und Prototyping

Verantwortung und Kommunikation:

  • Du hast mindestens ein Projekt selbst koordiniert, nicht nur daran mitgearbeitet

  • Du kannst Designentscheidungen gegenüber Partnern, Entwicklung und Geschäftsführung klar begründen

  • Du gehst offen mit Feedback um und bleibst trotzdem bei deiner Linie, wo sie für Nutzer:innen richtig ist

Ein Plus:

  • Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen (Medizintechnik, Pharma, Automotive o. ä.)

  • Kenntnisse in Barrierefreiheit (WCAG) und technisches Grundverständnis für Frontend und Mobile

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden, Jira und Confluence

  • Erfahrung mit Nutzerforschung, Usability-Tests und Designsystemen

Sprachkenntnisse:

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch (C1+) für die Zusammenarbeit mit Team und Partnern

  • Gutes Englisch (B2+) in Wort und Schrift

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltung mit Wirkung: Deine Designs werden in der medizinischen Diagnostik eingesetzt, und du hast spürbaren Einfluss auf ihre Richtung.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung: Vollzeit mit zwei Präsenztagen pro Woche in unserem Büro in Mannheim, der Rest flexibel und mobil.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Mindestens eine Konferenz oder ein Training pro Jahr; regulatorisches Know-how vermitteln wir dir im Onboarding.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Ein Team aus knapp 20 Leuten, flache Hierarchien und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Entwicklung: Du arbeitest täglich direkt mit unseren Web- und Mobile-Entwickler:innen zusammen, ohne lange Abstimmungsketten.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wir legen Wert auf einen transparenten und respektvollen Prozess:

  1. Screening-Gespräch (ca. 30 Min., remote)
    Gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmenbedingungen, erste fachliche Einordnung

  2. Fachliches Interview (ca. 90 Min., remote oder vor Ort)
    Du stellst ein bis zwei Projekte aus deinem Portfolio vor und zeigst uns eine deiner Design-Dateien. Anschließend bearbeiten wir gemeinsam eine fiktive, praxisnahe Fallstudie zu Design, Projektsteuerung und Partnerkommunikation. Eine Vorbereitung außer der Portfolio-Auswahl ist nicht nötig.

  3. Team-Kennenlernen (ca. 45 Min., idealerweise vor Ort)
    Austausch mit den Entwickler:innen, mit denen du eng zusammenarbeitest; kann mit Phase 2 kombiniert werden

Zeitrahmen: Von der Bewerbung bis zur Entscheidung planen wir etwa 2–3 Wochen. Spätestens zwei Werktage nach Eingang deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns, nach jeder Phase erhältst du zeitnah Feedback.

Noch unsicher?

Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung, fühlst dich aber angesprochen? Dann bewirb dich gern. Ein Lebenslauf und ein Link zu deinem Portfolio reichen uns zum Einstieg.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🚀 The Role

We’re hiring a GTM Senior Product Marketing Manager who wants to take our product from 1-100, not 0-1 scale.

You will join the fastest growing unit inside tem. This team is obsessed about growing our SMB customers and transforming their perception of energy beyond the bill, so we can hand more money and value back in their hands.

You will be a hands-on product marketer who can bring sharp judgment and voice of customer consistently back to the table. Your focus is to grow the trial, adoption and experience of our RED product and be ruthless in those goals. Expect to solve problems on your own and with product, content and engineers whilst running your own team of expert GTM agents.

Good looks like? Every 48 hours you’ll be:

  • Speaking to a customer.

  • Shipping a campaign with Claude.

  • Launching a piece of work that directly solves a customer problem.

  • Showing the goals move forward.

You’ll be 20% in architecting, 80% in delivery.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • User research: take control of it.

  • Assets: design and prototype assets to wow and educate our customers.

  • Demos: reinvent them.

  • Communications: untangle and re-build them.

  • Campaigns: drive promotional, time-sensitive campaigns.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Everyone at tem works from first principles, acts autonomously and builds. For this role, we also need these, in priority order:

    • Deeply analytical. You go to the numbers first and can explain what moved and why.

    • Taste and creative edge. You know what great looks like and the work shows it.

    • Outcome-minded. You can show which of your plays moved a number and which didn’t.

    • Customer-obsessed. You start from the customer’s problem, every time.

    • Strong risk appetite. You back bets before the data is complete, and cut them fast when they fail.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

Wir suchen eine:n Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (w/m/d) mit starkem Fokus auf Web-Produktentwicklung und AI/LLM-Integration. Du baust unser Team langfristig technisch mit auf und gestaltest unsere GovTech-Plattform für öffentliche Verwaltungen mit.

Standort: Remote-first aus Deutschland oder Österreich (mit gelegentlichen Teamtreffen nach Absprache und der Möglichkeit der Nutzung von Büros in Garching)

Start: Voraussichtlich ab 01.01.2027; den Einstiegstermin vereinbaren wir flexibel mit dir.

Vergütung: Gehalt nach Erfahrung und Expertise; Bonuszahlungen vorgesehen, Mitarbeiterbeteiligungen möglich.

Gesetzlich geforderte Information für Beschäftigung mit Arbeitsort Österreich, absolutes Mindestgehalt: In Österreich beträgt die Mindestvergütung auf Basis des IT-KV 2026 ab 4.061 € brutto monatlich bei 38,5 Wochenstunden, zuzüglich Sonderzahlungen. Das individuell geltende Mindestentgelt ergibt sich aus der Einstufung und den anrechenbaren Vordienstzeiten. Wir sind ausdrücklich bereit, über diesem Mindestentgelt zu bezahlen.

Über uns

Lexaru ist ein junges GovTech-/LegalTech-Startup, das Verwaltungsprozesse mit modernen Anwendungen digitalisiert. Unsere Produkte unterstützen Sachbearbeiter:innen im Verwaltungsalltag und tragen zu effizienter Verwaltung und besseren Services für Bürger:innen bei.

Wir entwickeln Fachanwendungen für Kommunal- und Landesverwaltungen und verbinden moderne Produktentwicklung mit KI-gestützten Funktionen in sicheren und nachvollziehbaren Systemen.

Unterstützt werden wir unter anderem durch das Legal Tech Colab der TU München und die Plattform AI Nation.

Was wir dir bieten

Du arbeitest remote-first mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Austausch mit den Gründern. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und gestaltest gesellschaftlich relevante Produkte für die öffentliche Verwaltung mit.

Wir unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch praktische Erfahrung, regelmäßiges Feedback und eigene Projekte.

Deine Entwicklung gestalten wir gemeinsam mit dir – durch technische Spezialisierung, wachsende Verantwortung oder Führungsaufgaben.

Deine Aufgaben

Produkt & Entwicklung

Du entwickelst Full-Stack Features und vollwertige interne Tools von der Idee über Architektur, Implementierung und Testing bis zum Rollout. Dazu gehören die Gestaltung einfacher UI/UX und das notwendige Backend Engineering. Du baust schnelle MVPs und entwickelst ausgereifte Funktionen für den produktiven Einsatz.

AI / LLM

Du konzipierst und entwickelst LLM-basierte Funktionen und agentische Workflows und integrierst sie in unsere Produkte. Dabei nutzt du Prompt- und Context Engineering, RAG, Tool Calling und strukturierte Modellausgaben. Du triffst Architektur- und Modellentscheidungen, entwickelst geeignete Evaluierungen und stellst durch Guardrails, Logging und Monitoring einen zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher. Qualität, Laufzeit und Kosten verbesserst du anhand messbarer Ergebnisse.

Architektur & Betrieb

Du wirkst an der Architektur unserer Plattform (Services, Datenmodell, Security) mit, verantwortest gemeinsam mit uns Deployment, CI/CD und Monitoring und achtest auf Security, Performance, Kosten und Stabilität im produktiven Betrieb.

Zusammenarbeit & Produktdenken

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und Kunden zusammen, übersetzt Nutzerbedürfnisse in technische Lösungen und klare User Stories und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Du wirkst an der Priorisierung mit und triffst pragmatische technische Entscheidungen.

Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in professioneller Full-Stack Produktentwicklung. Als Richtwert gelten vier oder mehr Jahre. Auch mit weniger Erfahrung freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du uns von deiner Expertise überzeugst.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript und modernen Frontend-Frameworks, idealerweise Svelte oder Vue.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in modernen Backend-Technologien wie Node.js oder Django.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken, idealerweise PostgreSQL, einschließlich Schema-Design und Grundlagen der Performanceoptimierung.

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb LLM-basierter Anwendungen, einschließlich RAG, Tool Calling und strukturierter Modellausgaben. Du kannst KI-Workflows eigenständig entwerfen, integrieren und ihre Qualität durch systematische Evaluation und Fehleranalyse weiterentwickeln.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, kommunizierst klar und bringst Aufgaben zu Ende. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen.

  • Du möchtest verstehen, wie Fachverfahren in Verwaltungen funktionieren, um sinnvolle UIs und Nutzerflüsse zu bauen.

  • Du kannst in einer frühen Phase mit wenigen Prozessstrukturen selbst priorisieren und Entscheidungen treffen.

  • Du führst saubere Dokumentation, zum Beispiel Architektur-Notizen, ADRs und Onboarding-Docs.

  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wir gehen den Bewerbungsprozess Schritt für Schritt mit dir durch. Du weißt dabei immer, wo du gerade stehst und was als Nächstes folgt.

  • Bewerbung über das Formular

  • Kurzes Kennenlernen – remote, ca. 20 Minuten

  • Take-Home Case – remote, ca. 120 Minuten

Nach erfolgreicher Bewertung deiner Bewerbung laden wir dich ein, einen vertraulichen Take-Home Case zu bearbeiten.

  • Technisches Gespräch über deinen Case – remote, ca. 90 Minuten

In einem zweiteiligen Gespräch besprechen wir deinen Case und deine Bewerbung einschließlich konkreter Vergütungsmodelle.

  • Persönliches Treffen zur Zusammenarbeit – vor Ort, ca. ein halber Tag

Wir sprechen über unsere Zusammenarbeit, Arbeitsweise und gegenseitigen Erwartungen. Deine Reisekosten übernehmen wir.

  • Angebot und gemeinsame Startplanung

Gleichbehandlung

Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung und sexueller Identität.

Datenschutz im Bewerbungsverfahren

Informationen zur Verarbeitung deiner Bewerbungsdaten nach Art. 13 DSGVO findest du in unseren Datenschutzhinweisen für Bewerber:innen auf www.lexaru.de

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About Payflows

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

  • Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

  • Investigate a performance or production issue.

  • Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

  • Review code and help teammates improve.

  • Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

  • Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools.

  • Core language: Python

  • Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic

  • Data: PostgreSQL

  • Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense

  • Performance: some Rust for critical paths

  • Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in.

Over the next year, we’ll focus on:

  • Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents

  • Simplifying services

  • Improving tests and observability

  • Making performance more predictable

  • Cleaning up early code

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step.


✨ Who’s going to thrive with us

You’ll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You like building products people actually use.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out.

  • You’re pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of:

  • Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans.

  • Designing reliable, safe automation in production.

  • Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly.

You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖

🧩 What you’ll get from this role

  • Real ownership over parts of the system.

  • Direct impact on customers and product decisions.

  • A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝

  • A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Flexible remote setup (we prefer people to come into Paris or London office twice per week. At a minimum we’d ask you to be at an office 3 days per month, onboard in Paris for your first few weeks, and work CEST timezone).

  • A high-autonomy environment where you have real ownership and space to make an impact.

  • Plenty of room to grow, take responsibility, and shape parts of the product.

  • A culture based on trust, ownership, and clear communication.

This isn’t a huge corporate environment. In exchange, you get autonomy, responsibility, and the chance to shape a product that’s still early in its story—and help build what finance operations will look like in the next decade 🚀

title: Customs AI Integration & Automation Engineer (France)
description:
About Customs Support Group

Customs Support Group (CSG) is the European market leader in customs services, operating across 15 countries. CSG is owned by private equity and a fast-growing, dynamic, data-driven company, dedicated to expanding its presence through strong organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Its key priorities include digital transformation, operational excellence and customer experience, all aimed at driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

The Role

You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the market.

This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant agentic AI solutions on top of foundation models document understanding, classification support, retrieval over our own procedures and tariff material, and agents that carry multi-step operational work end to end.

You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough that operations staff trust them with customs declarations, where being wrong has consequences.

Working closely with Operations, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and customise AI solutions for the market, from prototype through to production ownership.

• Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business

• Identify automation and decision-support opportunities across customs and business processes, and size them honestly before building.

• Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit.

• Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought.

• Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it.

• Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact.

• Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners.

• Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it.

.

Requirements

Essential

• 1-2 years AI engineering, software engineering or intelligent automation, including LLM or AI features that real users depended on.

• Strong Python and SQL, with production code ownership. Not familiarity.

• Demonstrable experience integrating large language models into production systems — prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and handling failure gracefully.

• Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex).

• Solid full stack backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, testing, CI/CD. Most of this job is

• Strong communication skills — you will spend real time with operations staff who are experts in customs and not in AI.

• Professional fluency in English.

Desirable

• Evaluation engineering: building eval harnesses and regression suites for non-deterministic systems, LLM-as-judge approaches, and human-in-the-loop review design. This is the single strongest signal we look for and we will weight it heavily.

• Context engineering: designing and version-controlling what a model sees — retrieval strategy, memory, tool descriptions, and policy layers that constrain what an agent is allowed to do.

• Agent orchestration frameworks and standards (LangGraph, MCP, Temporal or equivalent), and experience with long-running or multi-step agent workflows.

• Observability and cost control for inference at volume.

What success looks like in your first year

• By month three: You understand our customs processes well enough to challenge what we ask for, and you have shipped one small, useful thing.

• By month six: At least one AI solution is live, measured against a baseline, and demonstrably better than what it replaced.

• By month twelve: There is a working evaluation process others can use, a ranked pipeline of next opportunities, and at least two colleagues outside IT operating what you have built without you in the room.

What We Offer

• A key role in shaping AI capabilities.

• The opportunity to build solutions with direct business impact, on real operational volume rather than pilots that never leave the lab.

• An international and fast-evolving environment, with peers in other Customs Support Group markets working on the same problems.

• Professional growth opportunities, including a budget for conferences, certification and model/compute costs for your own experiments.

• Permanent role. Hybrid working.

How to apply

Send us your CV and a short note a few paragraphs is plenty describing one system you have put in front of real users. We are most interested in what went wrong with it and what you did about that.

title: Customer Success Associate

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

As a Customer Success Associate in EMEA, you will play a key role in scaling and strengthening our international post-sales experience as part of a growing global Customer Success organization. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support while helping shape and evolve the Customer Success experience across the EMEA region.

We are open to candidates based in the Netherlands who are willing to work in a hybrid model, at least 1 day per week in our Amsterdam office.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
💰 £40,000–£45,000

📍 Salary based on London. Other locations may vary.

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Behind the product is a finance function that needs to be as fast and reliable as the platform itself.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring an Assistant Accountant to own the accounting engine of the finance team: the ledger, the month-end close, and the admin that keeps both clean. Our day-to-day transaction processing is supported by an outsourced bookkeeping partner. You'll own the quality of that work, the reconciliations behind it, and everything between a receipt landing and a number reaching the board pack.

Everything else in finance, reporting, forecasting and investor diligence depends on the ledger being right. You'll make sure it is: reviewing what goes in, reconciling what comes out, and closing the month on time. About a quarter of the role is finance admin. It means running the invoice inbox, chasing receipts and keeping supplier records clean, and it's what keeps the numbers right.

🚀 What You'll Do

Ledger and close

  • Review and own the ledger in Xero, including our outsourced bookkeepers' work on coding, supplier bills and daily bank reconciliations across GBP, USD and EUR accounts

  • Prepare month-end journals, accruals and prepayments, and the balance sheet reconciliations behind them, so we close by working day 5 with our Finance Manager

  • Keep intercompany balances with our US entity reconciled

  • Reconcile payroll, PAYE and pension control accounts to Rippling each month

  • Prepare the UK VAT return in Xero for review

  • Prepare year-end schedules and answer queries from our external accountants and auditors

Finance admin and communication

  • Run the invoice inbox, logging, chasing and routing supplier invoices so nothing reaches the ledger without a document

  • Chase receipts and missing context from colleagues for card spend, and keep receipt compliance high

  • Maintain supplier records and support onboarding, including verifying bank details before anything is paid

  • Be the first point of contact for finance questions from the wider team

👀 Who You Are

  • 2 to 4 years in a finance team or accounting practice, with at least one month-end close owned end to end

  • AAT qualified, or studying towards or part-qualified in ACCA, CIMA or ACA. We'll support your studies

  • Confident in Xero or similar cloud accounting software, and comfortable with large data sets in Excel or Google Sheets

  • Experience with multi-currency reconciliations and high transaction volumes

  • Clear, friendly written communication. You'll chase people across the company and keep it pleasant

  • Fintech, marketplace or payments experience is a strong plus

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • A fully reconciled balance sheet gives you real satisfaction

  • You chase people for answers instead of waiting

  • You see the admin as part of getting the numbers right, not a distraction from it

  • You're comfortable in a startup where things move fast around you, even if your work is methodical

  • You want to grow into a management accountant or financial controller role as the team scales

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You want to work only on the numbers and see chasing colleagues for receipts as beneath the role

  • You need heavy supervision or detailed instructions for every task

  • You're not comfortable working with high transaction volumes daily

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Your work has immediate, visible impact. When the books are clean, the whole company moves faster, leadership gets reliable numbers, and investor conversations go smoothly

  • A clear path to grow, with study support and room to step up as the finance team expands

  • Fanvue supports hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans globally. The problems you solve here are real and immediate

  • Fully remote with unlimited PTO, flexible working hours, a London office and WeWork access when you want it

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Travel and office budgets for team off-sites or kitting out your home setup

  • A benefits package we're actively building out, including gym memberships and apps

  • A culture built on innovation, speed, excellence, ownership and transparency

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced partnerships leader to own and scale ElevenLabs’ strategic relationships with cloud hyperscalers and Systems Integrators, the companies whose platforms, field teams and delivery capacity sit at the heart of how enterprises buy and deploy voice and customer experience AI.

You’ll build and manage co-sell and marketplace programmes with AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, and build joint GTM and delivery motions with Regional and Global Systems Integrators. The goal: get ElevenLabs deeply embedded in hyperscaler partner networks and SI practices, so that when enterprises modernize their contact centers or build on cloud infrastructure, ElevenLabs is the natural AI voice layer, and partners have both the incentive and the capacity to sell and deliver it.

This is a 0→1 build in a high-leverage category. You’ll design co-sell and SI GTM frameworks, drive pipeline with hyperscaler field teams, structure marketplace and private offer motions, negotiate referral, resell and joint-offering agreements with SIs, and own the revenue and pipeline outcomes that come from these relationships.

  • Partner-sourced pipeline: qualified opportunities sourced or co-sold through hyperscaler and SI field teams each quarter

  • Field activation: measurable engagement with hyperscaler sellers and SI client partners and delivery teams, not just BD or alliance leads, translating to warm intros and joint account planning

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with hyperscaler co-sell programmes (AWS ISV Accelerate and ACE, Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Programme, Google Cloud Partner Advantage or equivalent) and marketplace operations (listings, private offers, commit burndown). You know how field co-sell actually works, not just the theory

  • Working knowledge of the SI ecosystem: relationships with practice leads and client partners at GSIs and RSIs, and an understanding of how SIs build practices, attach services to software ARR, and allocate delivery capacity

  • A builder mindset: experience creating co-sell and SI motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme

  • Comfortable with technical, API-driven products; able to work with solutions engineers to scope solution architectures and articulate ElevenLabs’ value to technical partner audiences

  • Experience building enablement, certification or reference architectures that activate partner field and delivery teams at scale

  • Based in North America

  • Bonus: background combining 3-4 years in a quota-carrying sales or solutions role with 3-4 years in partnerships or alliances; prior experience at a company that successfully scaled through cloud marketplace and SI channels

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America, with the ability to operate in US Eastern and Pacific timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco.
