title: GTM Enablement - Partner Program
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you'll build and run the ElevenLabs partner academy for systems integrators, hyperscalers and technology partners. You'll create curricula across sales, pre-sales and technical implementation, starting with ElevenAgents and expanding across ElevenCreative and ElevenAPI. You'll work closely with our regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who bring the technical expertise and set the technical quality bar. Your mission is to grow the program to 10,000+ certified partner professionals by the end of 2027, and to make the ElevenLabs certification a credential the tech ecosystem respects.

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you can expect to:

  • Build curricula for partner sellers, pre-sales and implementation engineers: courses, hands-on labs and assessments.

  • Turn expert knowledge from our FDEs, sales and product teams into a world-class online academy.

  • Run the certification program end to end, from submissions and review workflows to certificates, with FDEs making the technical call.

  • Scale the program through automation, from automated agent review to bots and emails that support learners.

  • Deliver training online and in person, including sales and technical sessions at our partner hackathons.

  • Run program administration: the learning platform, partner onboarding tracks, reporting and learner feedback.

Requirements

We're looking for an enablement builder who is comfortable with both commercial and technical topics. You don't need to be the deepest expert in the room, but you need enough depth to work with senior engineers and sellers as subject matter experts and turn their knowledge into great learning. You'll thrive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.

  • Have built enablement or training programs at scale for partners, sellers or technical teams.

  • Learn technical products quickly and can explain them to both technical and commercial audiences.

  • Can run a program end to end: learning platforms, timelines, stakeholders and reporting.

  • Can lead a session or workshop in front of sellers and engineers.

  • Have strong instructional design skills: you can turn expert content into clear courses, labs and assessments.

  • Enjoy turning repeat work into automations, tools and agents.

  • Have excellent communication skills and can adapt your message to different audiences.

Bonus:

  • Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or in professional services for a frontier AI product.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM applications or voice and chat agents, and reviewing whether they are ready for production.

  • Familiarity with Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks and common integration patterns.

  • Telephony experience, such as SIP, Twilio or contact center platforms.

  • Experience at a systems integrator, hyperscaler or technology partner.

  • Experience with learning platforms such as WorkRamp.

  • Proficient in Spanish or Portuguese.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Leading a partner enablement team as the academy grows.

  • Moving into partner program leadership or Solutions Engineering.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America, with the ability to operate in Americas timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.

This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

  • Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.
  • Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.
  • Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.
  • Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.
  • Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly.
  • Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear.
  • Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.
  • Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.
  • Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi-product enterprise environment  — not a single product or team's slice of it.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing.
  • Significant experience with modern vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Semgrep) and deep familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks such as CVSS and EPSS.
  • Strong AWS cloud services background.
  • Deep understanding of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).
  • Hands-on use of AI/LLM tooling in your own security workflow — triage, detection logic, remediation drafting — plus credibility speaking to how AI is changing the threat landscape and the tooling available to address it.
  • Location: must be based in central or eastern timezones.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with C/C++, relevant to firmware and embedded systems.
  • Background at a cloud-native, AI-forward company actively building agentic or AI-driven products.
  • Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda).
  • Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift-left" mentality.
  • Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP-certified environment.
  • Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting).

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

Horizon3 is committed to defending businesses from the ever-growing threat landscape. Our advanced solutions and expert team provide unparalleled security for our clients. We are looking for a passionate Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect to join our team and help prospects and clients understand the true value and capabilities of our products and services.

  • Customer engagement - Meet with potential customers to understand their cybersecurity needs, challenges, and infrastructure, ensuring that our solutions are the perfect fit for them

  • Product demonstrations - Provide live demos and proof of concepts for our cybersecurity solutions, tailoring each demo to the specific needs and concerns of the potential customer

  • Solution development - Will work closely with the sales and product teams to design and refine our solutions based on customer needs

  • Technical training - train the sales team on the technical aspects of our products to enhance their ability to sell more effectively

  • RFP/RFI assistance - Assist in answering technical sections of RFPs and RFIs

  • Post-sales support - On rare occasions, assist in post-sales processes to ensure the smooth implementation and satisfaction of our customers

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Pre-Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect in the cybersecurity domain

  • Strong understanding of cyber threats, risk management, and cybersecurity solutions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Demonstrated ability to simplify complex technical topics for a non-technical audience

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Depending on experience, the compensation range for this position is: €160,000 - €190,000 OTE 70/30 split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for an iOS Engineer to join our growing mobile team and build the Creative App (iOS), bringing our audio AI to millions of users. You’ll ship features that integrate tightly with our AI-driven audio models, and work out where focused bets or incremental improvements will move the product most.

You’re impact-driven and autonomous, and good at drawing clear conclusions from experimental results. You’ll work closely with design, product and research, and help shape the app’s architecture and technical direction.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities, and able to add structure where it’s needed

Bonus

  • Experience with audio playback or streaming on iOS

  • Experience building mobile infrastructure for build, test and release pipelines

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate in GMT to GMT+4 timezones preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin, Amsterdam and Paris.

title: Product Marketing Lead
description:
About Orakl Oncology

Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials and every failure costs patients precious time .

Orakl exists to change those odds.

We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients: real patients’ tumors, paired with their medical history and deep biological data. By combining patient-derived tumor models, deep biological data and AI, we help pharmaceutical companies predict how cancer drugs will perform in patients, identify promising treatments and make better decisions earlier in development.

We were founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès, PhD and Gustave Ronteix, PhD as a spin-out from Gustave Roussy, one of Europe's leading cancer centers, building on a decade of research. We are backed by top international VC investors and we are scaling our technology and partnerships with pharmaceutical companies worldwide.

Discover more here: Orakl's website.

The role

We are looking for Orakl's first Product Marketing Lead to shape how we bring our technology to market, from understanding our customers and positioning our offerings to building the commercial narratives and tools that help us win.

You will sit at the intersection of science, product and business development, turning complex scientific capabilities into compelling propositions for pharma and biotech customers.

title: Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer
description:
What we are building

Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.

Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Our team

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Our approach to engineering

  • We prioritize customer needs first

  • We work in small, project-based teams

  • We have flexibility in terms of the problems we work on

  • We own the full lifecycle of our projects

  • We avoid silos and encourage taking up tasks in new areas

  • We balance quality and velocity

  • We have a shared responsibility for our production code

  • We each set our own routine to maximize our productivity

 

Your mission

 

You’ll join us as a Machine Learning Engineer/ Data Scientist for Mimica’s Data Intelligence team, whose goal is to transform raw recorded data into clean, structured, anonymized data that powers the work of other teams.

You’ll own key parts of our ML pipelines end to end, making them more accurate, cost-efficient, and trustworthy. Along the way, you’ll build evaluations and LLM judges, run experiments, and transform promising results into validated production improvements.

Your work will be applied and LLM-heavy, with opportunities to evaluate and fine-tune open-source models and build smaller, task-specific models.

If you enjoy taking ML beyond experiments, this is your chance to shape the systems at the heart of Mimica’s products and see your work deliver value to real users at scale.

 

Part of your day-to-day

 

  • Own, debug, and improve production pipelines for accuracy and efficiency.

  • Design, build, and iterate on LLM evals and LLM-as-a-judge systems, including the datasets, metrics, and benchmarks to monitor quality.

  • Run rigorous experiments on prompts, pipeline design, model choice, and inputs (e.g., OCR text vs. image + OCR), and turn the results into clear recommendations.

  • Drive LLM efficiency improvements across our pipelines by comparing models, restructuring steps, and replacing LLM calls with smaller, purpose-built models where it makes sense.

description:
About BeInCrypto

BeInCrypto is a part of the media group BeInNews Ltd, a global newsroom and research team covering institutional finance and digital assets as they intersect: regulation, trading infrastructure, and market structure - backed by original data and a team reporting from every major time zone. Our 100+ journalists and analysts operate across 50+ countries, publishing in 26 languages. We are official media partners at Money20/20, Digital Assets Forum London, Korea Blockchain Week, Token2049, Proof of Talk, and other leading industry events.

About the role

We are seeking a hands-on Research Analyst to develop and deliver high-quality institutional research at the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets. You will take ownership of the research process, from identifying relevant topics and analysing data to producing insightful, accurate, and publication-ready reports.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the end-to-end research process, from identifying relevant topics and developing research angles to data analysis, report writing, and final quality control.

  • Produce clear, insightful, institutional-grade research reports covering traditional finance, digital assets, market trends, and emerging opportunities.

  • Critically evaluate data, challenge assumptions, identify inconsistencies, and ensure the accuracy and credibility of research findings, including AI-generated content.

  • Identify relevant industry trends, research opportunities, and insights that resonate with institutional audiences.

  • Collaborate with editorial, product, design, and commercial teams to develop valuable research products, including reports, indices, and premium research offerings.

  • Engage with industry experts and data providers when needed to gather insights, validate findings, and strengthen research quality.

You are the perfect match if you:

  • Have proven hands-on experience in traditional finance research, financial journalism, or market intelligence, ideally with exposure to digital assets.

  • Have experience working at an established financial research firm, financial institution, market intelligence provider, or leading financial media outlet.

  • Can independently manage research projects from initial analysis to a complete, publication-ready report.

  • Have strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, challenge conclusions, and develop original insights.

  • Can produce well-structured, accurate, and engaging research reports in fluent English.

  • Are confident working with financial data, research platforms, and AI tools while independently validating and improving their outputs.

  • Understand institutional financial markets and can identify research topics relevant to professional audiences.

  • Have a product mindset and understand how high-quality research can create value for audiences and support commercial opportunities.

What we offer to you:

  • 100% remote work with no location restrictions.

  • Flexible working hours with no time tracking and no mandatory meetings outside your timezone.

  • Paid time off to recharge.

description:

We are a fast-growing Series A startup building cutting-edge technology to revolutionize cloud development processes and support highly efficient dev&test feedback loops. We’ve closed our last $25mil round in Q4 2024, led by Notable Capital, CRV and Heavybit.

LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

The cloud was built to run software, not to support AI-native development workflows. As the world's leading local cloud development platform, LocalStack provides secure local sandboxes that simulate cloud environments, enabling AI agents and software developers to find and fix risks faster and more effectively than they can in the cloud.

Our customer base ranges from SMBs to Global Fortune 500 companies. Our clients include companies like NASA, Harness, IBM, Workday, Comcast, Apple, 3M, Block and many more.

LocalStack is headquartered in Zurich/Switzerland 🇨🇭, with a small engineering office in Vienna/Austria 🇦🇹 and remote team members from 25 countries including 🇺🇸the US, 🇫🇷FR, 🇬🇧UK, 🇨🇦CA, 🇪🇸ES, and many more!

👉Check our Notion Candidate Handbook and our GitHub!

✅ What you will be working on/responsible for

  • Own the internal cloud infrastructure and serve as the primary point of contact for cloud operations and infrastructure requests.

  • Manage and continuously improve our multi-account cloud environment, ensuring security, governance, and compliance best practices are consistently applied.

  • Support and maintain compliance with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, ensuring audit evidence is prepared continuously rather than only during audit periods.

  • Operate and improve our identity and access management, including SSO, MFA, permissions, and joiner/mover/leaver processes.

  • Maintain and monitor self-hosted internal services, ensuring they meet agreed service levels and that vulnerabilities are tracked and resolved efficiently.

  • Cloud cost management / FinOps fundamentals

  • Azure is a nice-to-have extension, not a requirement - AWS depth is what matters, but the estate is going multi-cloud so appetite for it counts

  • Bash, Python and/or Go for tooling. Comfortable with ambiguity in a remote-first environment, and happy being the first hire in a function

  • Care: we create with compassion. We prioritize empathy and understanding in every interaction. By genuinely caring for our team, customers, and community, we create an environment where people thrive and impactful work flourishes

  • Openness: we build trust together. We build trust through open communication and honest feedback. By sharing ideas and embracing diverse perspectives, we create stronger, more connected teams that work toward shared goals.

  • Courage: we dare to innovate. We embrace bold challenges and take calculated risks to move the needle. We step outside our comfort zones, experiment fearlessly, and turn setbacks into springboards for growth.

Excellence: we chase the extraordinary. We chase excellence by pushing boundaries and delivering results that go beyond the ordinary, constantly raising the bar and striving for greatness in everything we do. Excellence is not just the outcome, itʼs how we approach every task with purpose, passion, and a commitment to delivering exceptional value.

description:
SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. title: Frontend Engineer
description:
About Shiftbase

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human.

Year one, in order

First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release.

Then, own an area. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself.

Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. We move fast and keep quality up by automating what a human doesn't need to do, including the checks that catch what an agent got wrong.

What you'll do

  • Design and build frontend features starting from rough product ideas

  • Deliver features with Claude Code, from the prompt through to the pull request, and review the output as closely as a colleague's

  • Write the patterns, conventions and project context our agents work from, so generated frontend code lands in the right shape

  • Turn tangled domain rules into screens people can use without a manual

  • Fix bugs in your own features and in code you've never seen

  • Improve the code you touch while you touch it, so the next feature in that area costs less

  • Write and maintain automated tests in Jest and Playwright

  • Ship in short cycles with your product team

  • Pair, review, and teach what you know

How we work

Frontend in Angular, backend in PHP, a web app and a mobile app in React Native. Tests in Jest and Playwright. We develop AI-assisted with Claude Code as the primary tool, and a growing share of our code starts there. Human review and engineers owning what they ship keep it safe. We ship in short cycles in product teams with mixed specialisations. We pair often, with each other and with an agent open. Every quarter you get time to build and ship one of your own ideas, and we run hackathons.




Must-haves

3+ years of professional experience with an SPA framework, Angular preferred. Depth in React or Vue works if you can show you'll carry it over.

You ship. You've delivered features to real users at a steady pace, and you can tell us what you cut to get them out.

You've shipped production code with an AI agent. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar. Tell us where you let it run, where you took the keyboard back, and what you changed about your own workflow after a month of it.

You automate your tests. Jest and Playwright, or equivalents, and you have an opinion about what deserves a test.

You simplify. Hand you a tangled domain problem and you produce a screen that hides the tangle.

You explain your choices. In review, in a design discussion, and to a product manager who doesn't read code.

You work as a peer. You pair, you review, and you make the people around you better without needing a title to be heard.

Nice-to-haves

  • Claude Code in particular, or agent setups you've tuned for a team rather than yourself

  • TypeScript at depth

  • Storybook or component library ownership

  • React

  • TDD

  • PHP, or enough backend to reason about the API you're consuming

  • Familiarity with a complex, regulated domain (ours covers scheduling, time tracking, leave, and labour law across countries)

This might be your dream job if…

✅ You want your work in front of customers within days

✅ You'd rather own a feature end to end than take a finished spec

✅ You want a say in how a team writes frontend code with agents while the answer is still open

✅ You improve the code you touch without being asked, and you stop before it turns into a six-week rewrite

✅ You like a domain that takes months to learn

This probably isn't your dream job if…

⛔️ You want the technical approach decided before the ticket reaches you

⛔️ You want a job where AI stays out of your editor

⛔️ You'd merge agent output you can't explain in review

⛔️ You'd stop shipping to finish a refactor

⛔️ You prefer pixel work and would rather leave tests and architecture to someone else

⛔️ You'd rather work alone than pair and review

What we offer

  • A laptop on Mac, Windows, or Linux

  • 32 or 40 hours workweek

  • Hybrid, from home or the Zoetermeer office

  • 25 vacation days based on a 40-hour contract

  • Pension plan

  • NS business card or travel expenses reimbursed.

  • Training budget for personal development

Please be aware that this is not a remote position and we are not taking applications in consideration outside of the Netherlands for this position.

description:
Take ownership of the AI behind our clinical products in the US: an AI therapist delivering end-to-end care, and AI assessment used by healthcare providers.

About Limbic

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians.

Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomised, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill.

The Role

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you have demonstrated experience in AI product development and will take ownership of translating AI research into products that tangibly improve patients’ lives. You will join one of our two product teams building for the US market, and we will work with you to find the one where your strengths have the most impact:

  • AI therapy: a voice agent delivering structured CBT over the phone to adults with depression and anxiety, with licensed clinicians overseeing care. It is live with Medicare patients and growing every week.

  • AI assessment: a conversational agent that US healthcare organisations configure to assess patients, administer clinical questionnaires, detect risk and recommend the right treatment programme, so patients reach the right care faster.

Both teams build on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so the systems you design are reused across the company, and you will be expected to bring your successes cross-product.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the AI quality of a live clinical product end to end, from framing problems with clinicians and product managers to shipping, monitoring and improving in production.

  • Design and build agentic systems, including orchestration of specialised agents, tools and memory, that stay fast enough for real-time voice and text conversations.

  • Build and improve the safety systems that screen every patient message and every AI reply, from real-time risk detection to guardrails against unsafe or clinically inappropriate responses.

  • Lead eval-driven development: evaluation suites, simulated patients and LLM-as-judge autolabellers validated against clinician labels, so we ship with confidence and catch regressions before patients do.

  • Productionise ML models that optimise product KPIs, such as triage accuracy, treatment completion and recovery rates, and identify the causal factors that drive them.

  • Help turn our clinical AI into composable services that healthcare partners can integrate into their own patient journeys.

  • Raise the engineering bar through architecture, code review and mentorship, while keeping our AI continuously compliant with strict regulatory requirements.

What You’ll Bring

  • You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds:

    • A PhD in computational science or an AI-related field, plus 2 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

    • OR A BSc/MSc, plus 4 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

  • Expertise in productising LLM features and a strong background in eval-driven development.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Proven experience building an LLM agent harness.

  • Experience utilising reinforcement learning.

  • Strong architectural skills with experience designing scalable, production-grade systems for machine learning applications.

  • A solid understanding of statistical principles in the context of LLM evaluation and user activity analytics.

  • Proficiency with version control systems (preferably Git) and databases (SQL or NoSQL).

  • Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform and containerisation technologies.

  • A track record of end-to-end ownership: you scope work you can ship quickly, measure its impact, and keep a sense of urgency when the stakes are high.

  • A genuine interest in applying your technical skills to solve complex challenges in the mental healthcare space.

  • Ideal but not required: Experience with real-time voice AI, or with healthcare organisations as customers.

  • The ability to work from our London (Spitalfields) office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or from the office on other days of the week. As you will work on products for the US, expect some meetings in the late afternoon UK time.

  • We can consider visa sponsorship for candidates relocating to London.

Benefits & Wellbeing

  • Competitive salary and equity share options.

  • An amazing office in central London (Spitalfields) for our collaborative team days on Tuesdays and Thursdays, paired with a flexible/hybrid working model on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.

  • 25 days PTO plus bank holidays.

  • Company pension scheme (UK).

  • Enhanced parental leave packages (UK).

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.

  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. title: 3D Chiplet Engineer
description:
About Us : AI compute is hitting a hard physical wall, and memory bottlenecks are throttling the entire industry. Founded in October 2024 and backed by €57M in funding, Vertical Compute is solving this with proprietary Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) chiplets, making AI hardware faster, greener, and vastly more scalable. We are an interdisciplinary team transforming breakthrough semiconductor physics into commercial reality.

Why Now : After 18 months of intensive R&D, Vertical Compute has reached a critical inflection point. Our underlying technology is validated, and we have successfully met our core technical milestones. Armed with a proven technical data package and ongoing system studies, we are now shifting from pure R&D to active engagement with global enterprise customers. As we prepare for our next phase of scale and growth starting in 2027, joining us today means taking direct ownership of the hardware foundation that will power the next era of AI compute.

About the role: 

We are looking for a 3D Integration / Chiplet Expert to define and implement 2.5D/3D advanced packaging solutions for our Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM) technology. You will collaborate across teams to define optimal interconnect strategies and die stacking approaches to enable high-bandwidth, low-power operation. This job sits at the intersection of SoC architecture (specifically the physical design) , package design, and 3D manufacturing processes. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Integration Architecture & Process Definition:
    Develop and define architectures for 2.5D/3D stacking of VIM chiplets with compute chiplets.
    Collaborate with design and technology teams to develop interconnect solutions that ensure high bandwidth and low latency.
    Define clearly the impact of the chiplet physical design chiplets (through-silicon vias, micro-bumps, hybrid bonds, redistribution layers, and chiplet interfaces, …)
    define fabrication flows and design rules with foundries, packaging partners, and internal physical design teams

  • Performance Analysis & Simulation:
    Conduct early multi-physics simulations (thermal, electrical, mechanical) to analyze and optimize the performance and reliability of integrated systems.
    drive external partners for final package design

  • Collaboration & Communication:
    Partner closely with design, process engineering, metrology, and system architecture teams.
    Participate in conferences, standardization bodies and industry events to promote or lead discussions about the future of chiplet integration.

  • Technical Leadership:Provide
    technical leadership and project management guidance to multidisciplinary  teams.

About the team: 

This role is part of the Product & system team, partnering closely with our cross-functional engineering teams in Product & system  and Memory Design. We foster a highly collaborative, inclusive environment where strong alignment, high transparency and seamless team coordination are central to our shared success.



About who you are:

  • You’ve spent 5–10 years exploring the frontiers of 2.5D/3D packaging and heterogeneous integration, turning complex ideas into manufacturable systems.

  • You have a deep understanding on the SoC physical design, TSVs, Redistribution Layers, hybrid bonding and how they are used at system level to implement chip IOs (Functional and power IOs)   

  • You are mastering Integrity 3D-IC Platform to define the chiplets interface, to define 3D stacking system, to generate the 3Dblox views, and to run all the 3D system level analysis (Power Delivery Network, Thermal, STA, LVS, SI/PI, …)    

  • You thrive where architecture meets technology — translating ambitious concepts into elegant, high-performance designs.

  • Multi-physics isn’t just theory to you; you use thermal, electrical, and mechanical simulations to see the whole system clearly.

  • You’re naturally collaborative — just as comfortable in technical deep dives as you are building bridges between design, process, and system teams.

  • You’re the kind of engineer who balances vision with execution: leading projects, mentoring peers, and pushing boundaries with a calm hand.

  • Above all, you’re curious — drawn to the challenge of building something new and meaningful at the intersection of memory, compute, and packaging innovation.

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities.


Why Join Us:

  • You will get the opportunity to work at the forefront of memory technology innovation.

  • Vertical Compute is not only a state-of-the art but also a human adventure. We believe you must have a lot of fun developing the best of you. Making sure you and your team are going to enjoy the journey and become passionate about what we do is a key goal of our founders.

  • You can be part of a talented and dedicated team in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • In this role, you contribute to projects that will have a significant impact on the future of computing and electronics.

  • You can count on a motivating total rewards package.

  • Flexible ways of working.

Join us in shaping the future of compute & memory technology — and celebrating success!

title: Software Engineer - Map & Route
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Map & Route Team

Our Map & Route team sits within Wayve’s Automotive Platforms division in Vehicle Software Engineering, and builds the geospatial foundations behind our AI driver. Working with global-scale data, the team turns road-network and navigation data into reliable products used across Wayve, building geospatial services and data products to support company operations. We work with our model development, experimentation, and evaluation platforms to build an AI driver that uses maps and navigation data like an expert human driver by using map information to enhance training and evaluation of performance. We are a full-stack team owning mapping end to end, getting to touch work that is infrastructure, data engineering, data science, backend and frontend.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Write full-stack services in Python and Typescript, creating novel geospatial services to solve challenging and unique problems we face in building our AI driving products.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to understand requirements and build solutions with global geospatial data.

  • Design and build data pipelines with PySpark and Databricks to enrich fleet data with mapping and road-network information at global scale.

  • Build applications and datasets that support route planning and the preparation of map data for training and simulation.

  • Integrate with navigation and mapping APIs from providers such as Mapbox, TomTom and Google Maps.

  • Maintain, support and improve the services the team already runs.

  • Deploy and operate your services on Azure and Kubernetes, owning them end to end.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Global-scale geospatial enrichment pipelines that tell us where we’ve driven and what the road network looks like.

  • Route-planning applications and datasets that help our teams decide where to drive next.

  • Map data preparation for model training and simulation.

  • New services you’ll take from idea to production and lead end to end.

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • You are a strong, hands-on Python engineer who can deliver high-quality production code at pace.

  • You are comfortable with an AI-assisted or AI engineering workflow (ideation, planning, implementation and review).

  • You have built and operated large-scale data pipelines using Spark or PySpark.

  • You are comfortable writing SQL to query and analyse large datasets.

  • You have working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and container orchestration, ideally Azure and Kubernetes, and are happy to own deployment, monitoring, and observability of your services.

  • You enjoy taking ownership of new services and seeing them through end to end.

  • Experience with geospatial data processing, road-network data or routing engines (e.g. OpenStreetMap, TomTom, HERE or Overture data, PostGIS, navigation APIs) would be a strong advantage.

  • Experience with Bazel or monorepo build systems is desirable but not mandatory.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Flyte or Airflow would be a bonus.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency interviews: Python Programming (60 mins) and Hiring Manager interview (45 mins)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews: Systems Design (60 mins) and Domain interview (60 mins)

  • Final interview: Mission and Values Alignment (45 mins).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

description:

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

  • Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

  • Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

  • Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

  • Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

  • Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

 

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

  • Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

    • Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

    • NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

    • JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

  • A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

  • Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

  • A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

  • Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

  • Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

 

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer

  • Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

  • Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

  • Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

  • Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer

  • Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

  • Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

  • Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

  • Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP

  • Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

  • Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

  • Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

  • Team: regular team events.

Practical information

  • Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

  • If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.
